I'm running to bring commonsense conservative solutions to Washington so we can get America back on track I launched my campaign for the United States Senate four weeks ago. I’ve been humbled by the strong level of support we’ve seen talking about the commonsense conservative solutions I’ll take to D.C. to help solve the issues affecting our daily lives. Fellow Conservative, The superpower that has made our country great isn’t our government; it isn’t our military or our economy – it’s the mind and spirit of free people. Please take a few moments if you can spare them to watch the video I’ve linked [see above] , recapping the first four weeks on the campaign trail. We have a lot of ground to cover, many people to meet, anda great deal of money to raise over the next 18 months. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. Yesterday’s thirst strike was incredible.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67109651/418645018/1120393829?refcode=em-wrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjhlZWExNy0xOTJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7DgM_eUTb_kQFktnYi2rsEZqB7tOhJyjN3w9kKOF2sk=&emci=33390648-ed2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=d68eea17-192c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=6830379)
Yesterday was incredible, Peter**.**

**I was in the sun on the Capitol steps for nearly NINE hours without water or food, in solidarity with workers in Texas and across the nation.**

I held this thirst strike to push for federal heat safety protections for workers, which currently don’t exist— _and the response was inspiring._
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67109652/418645019/-1745368503?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjhlZWExNy0xOTJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7DgM_eUTb_kQFktnYi2rsEZqB7tOhJyjN3w9kKOF2sk=)

I was joined by dozens of workers from Texas who have suffered from a lack of water breaks and respect at work, as well as fantastic colleagues like Sen. Bernie Sanders, Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries, among many others.

I may have not had a sip to drink for nine hours in the sun, but I felt truly energized to get this done.

**We won’t stop fighting for federal heat safety regulations, so politicians like Greg Abbott can’t sell away workers’ rights. Can you help us keep up the fight?**

**[Can you chip in $10, $20, or $30 to help us guarantee workers’ rights to basic protections like water breaks?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67109653/418645020/-1745368503?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjhlZWExNy0xOTJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7DgM_eUTb_kQFktnYi2rsEZqB7tOhJyjN3w9kKOF2sk=) **With a groundswell of grassroots support I think we can be successful.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67109654/418645021/2097596723?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjhlZWExNy0xOTJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7DgM_eUTb_kQFktnYi2rsEZqB7tOhJyjN3w9kKOF2sk=&emci=33390648-ed2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=d68eea17-192c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=6830379)
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67109655/418645023/2097596723?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjhlZWExNy0xOTJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7DgM_eUTb_kQFktnYi2rsEZqB7tOhJyjN3w9kKOF2sk=&emci=33390648-ed2b-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=d68eea17-192c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=6830379)

But as a lifelong labor organizer, I know the power of bold, collective action. Together, we’re tougher than any governor or right wing lobby. With federal heat safety regulations, we can override Abbott’s cruel new law.

That’s why we’re urging the Biden administration to protect workers’ rights to basic things like water breaks.**[The momentum is on our side—with your help, I think we can get it done. Chip in $10, $20, or $30 to help us push for federal protections.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67109657/418645026/-1745368503?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNjhlZWExNy0xOTJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7DgM_eUTb_kQFktnYi2rsEZqB7tOhJyjN3w9kKOF2sk=)**

-Greg

clean_body: Yesterday’s thirst strike was incredible. Yesterday was incredible, Peter. I was in the sun on the Capitol steps for nearly NINE hours without water or food, in solidarity with workers in Texas and across the nation. I held this thirst strike to push for federal heat safety protections for workers, which currently don’t exist— and the response was inspiring. = I was joined by dozens of workers from Texas who have suffered from a lack of water breaks and respect at work, as well as fantastic colleagues like Sen. Bernie Sanders, Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries, among many others. I may have not had a sip to drink for nine hours in the sun, but I felt truly energized to get this done. We won’t stop fighting for federal heat safety regulations, so politicians like Greg Abbott can’t sell away workers’ rights. Can you help us keep up the fight? = With a groundswell of grassroots support I think we can be successful. **= Peter, 13 years ago, I organized a thirst strike to push cities in Texas to guarantee basic worker protections like water breaks. But because of a terrible new law signed by Greg Abbott in the middle of a historic heatwave, those rights will soon disappear. But as a lifelong labor organizer, I know the power of bold, collective action. Together, we’re tougher than any governor or right wing lobby. With federal heat safety regulations, we can override Abbott’s cruel new law. That’s why we’re urging the Biden administration to protect workers’ rights to basic things like water breaks.= In solidarity, -Greg Greg Casar Congressman Texas Congressional District 35 ****=** | ****** ---|---

Greg Casar staged a thirst strike on the Capitol steps to bring attention to the plight of workers forced to work in extreme heat without water breaks. | | | Peter — Yesterday, Rep. Greg Casar, who represents Austin, TX, staged a thirst strike on the Capitol steps to bring attention to the plight of workers forced to work in extreme heat without water breaks. 1 Rep. Casar is calling on the Biden Administration to take action and guarantee heat safety protections for all workers. Peter, right now there is no federal law mandating water breaks for workers in extreme heat. This, despite the fact that extreme heat kills more Americans than hurricanes, tornadoes, and floods every year.2 In the hottest summer on record, with temperatures surging up to 115 degrees in some parts of Texas, the need for action is urgent — and lives are on the line.3 Rep. Casar’s call for a federal mandate for water breaks comes after Texas Governor Greg Abbott passed a law that overrides local ordinances mandating water breaks for workers outdoors. This cruel and inhumane law overturned ordinances in Austin and Dallas that have proven to save lives. Already, at least three workers have died this summer from extreme heat exposure in Texas since Abbott’s law was passed. 4 And with climate scientists warning that deadly heat waves will become more common in years to come, we can’t look the other way as this preventable death toll rises. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , The Texas Tribune, July 25, 2023 2\. , The Texas Tribune, June 30, 2023 3\. , ABC News, June 29, 2023 4\. , Texas Observer, July 6, 2023 Thoughts? | | | My birthday is coming up, and the gift I really want is to celebrate it with you, my core team of supporters. Can you join us for food, fun and maybe an embarrassing round of “Happy Birthday"? Wednesday, August 9th
5:30 pm Plumbers Union Hall
1519 Rollins Road, Burlingame [](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=b77c2743d1&e=c0babbc643) Turning another year older is a good reminder of how much I love the job of representing you on the Board of Supervisors, and how much important work we still have to do together:
* Preparing for climate change by making investments to combat wildfires, flooding and sea level rise
* Improving health care, including greater access to mental health services and interventions
* Housing homeless individuals and families and providing intensive wraparound services such as job training

[](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=1ae0adcd56&e=c0babbc643) I would still very much appreciate anything you can donate – the limit for this race is $2,000 per donor and every dollar helps get our message out! Hope to see you August 9th! Best regards, David Canepa, San Mateo County Supervisor, District 5 P.S. No matter the size of your contribution, donating today is the best birthday present you could give me – I would be so grateful if you could [pitch in](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=9925e8117f&e=c0babbc643) today. **Paid for by David Canepa for Supervisor 2024, ID# 1399463**

**FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ** Dear Fellow American, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism - mostly the latter - and just how important and rare it is to get things right. In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts. **The New York Sun is different. It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.** Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point. When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments. The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate. It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism. I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join. **The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. **[I highly encourage you to join the Sun today. ](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)**
---
[**Join the Sun Now →**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
Every person matters in this effort. Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.
---
---
**Alan Dershowitz** Columnist, The New York Sun

## Hunter Biden Plea Deal Derailed by Judge
Hunter Biden's deal to avoid jail by pleading guilty to tax charges [fell apart Wednesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOszAQhJ_GdEbrNcFQUPwNXf72SmTwAhs5mIMlXN7-ROrrpvhGM_q-7t3dc-Rl-u-f1MiYOj8Iv6gDp9FptB1moRmJkGxGjSlrKG6lMSabm1tfearLsg5j5YZQ1DfAggqwvTUE5DNuENCCQwe1dQZyFwhG7ENVFc4H9KoACixpyx-JF5lpjO_0oi0f0jOLzSyy7sr-U9gqbM_zzNcUWXhIF6CwXejcFbbXisIW3JVLhe18LEKb7jnQotdIPux6SaKng6O8tSQt_kcPs98m2rUfL_hxhIn090G7cFr2T00H8lEDGKgsmGxrwnpyjLyXThUwPT3Hz1X529xvAAAA__8cR29U) after a federal judge questioned the scope of the agreement and whether it would shield Biden from other charges in the future. Pressed by the judge, Justice Department prosecutors admitted [they were still investigating Biden's activities.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFurDAQheGnMZ2RPeZiKFzchm7TpkSzeLxM5MXIzC7J20cbpUx59DVH__tlviBn3m5veKcgqcy4CD9pNl6D1-BmaGJIRECuoWD70XT_emttswbbRYueyKXRR98P4-ASJkjjAtZ1iA0HMOCMB29G561pfSST4BqHofMYAVVnKLKU2n4U3mSllL_Kk2q7lHuTwyqyH8r9VzApmM7zbFP53Og8Xq5g2ktm4eVQMK2PTajqK0fa9J4JdSTMGvedsB46YX4NrKIT10P0Uh5Vfhm3hZoa4n5yznz0XnXmdkfOPzfk7yrfAQAA__-uW2a1) That caused Biden's defense attorneys to pull out of the agreement. In the end, Biden pleaded not guilty to the tax charges. His lawyers and the Justice Department will now have to negotiate a new agreement or go to trial.
## Carmakers Plan Vast EV-Charging Network
Seven large automakers, including GM, BMW, Honda, Hyundai, and Kia, announced a joint venture to create [a massive recharging network](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuhDAQRL_GdD6ZxWAoXKShu7Qp0WIv4JyxT2aPU_4-InW6kUYzenpf9-mOIYa0fuJOlpc8oeNw0qSMBCOhmaDydiECaiqydTco3XZ1XVeb7QanaV5m1_aD03ruYFB937cevAZq2ipYUNAoA0YNjanVzXhSC8y-77VBDyi0Ih84l9t3Dok3WuJPPqncXN6raDfm5yGaDwGjgJHJba68ktuuWsB4nQsYlblyJ2CMhD6kVeKL844PKod8YuFERXKWrhAyyR2PI5wk6ZRuw7Jeg0T8zuUhYKyK9c93iDEcnRFarTuG-IfD_9v5DQAA__9VZmZq) across North America for electric cars.

The first U.S. charging stations are set to open next summer, first in big cities and major highways and then in popular travel and vacation routes. Ultimately the plan is to build [30,000 charging stations](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGypCAQheGnwQwLWgUnMNjEbDbd0GqlVWYQpqAda99-y41vfE7w1_fnOT3RBx-333jQwGuacGH_pUlZCVZCM0HlhpUIqKlo0Oah2s5orat96J11a9evrX4Y1beztnbWS2uapTPW9F3lB1DQKAtWPRqrVW0dqRVm1_etRQcoWkXOc8r1K_nIO63hb_pSrpd0VGHYmT9FNL8EjALG67rqTCdTLvcuYJzP4iOVImDEk1ORnDGWT8qM7FMUMC47hkBxI8lUAsoDXynL-3zgm3KRAc-47JK-ctkxbz5uMhJfKb_l3S5vBiNgrPLgPpcPwRdjRau2A334n8k_q_0LAAD__3L3cBE).

The total cost for the build will be in the billions of dollars. The new stations will support Tesla's charging standards but also compete with the existing Tesla network.
## Feds Hiding Alien Tech, Witness Tells Congress
David Grusch, a former Air Force intelligence officer, told Congress the government is [hiding a longstanding program](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7ojwYnuhoHhNurz2SmuBJeZEjGVIrPz9KVdfOZpmNF-35UYpp-3-nx5sWywL-ZZevEgUgALUAn2wkRlY9WyH2chxmodh6FcbjPGoFGo9RRgl6Bj84EKkeTAGJ9knCxKUREBpFA7ygoFlBBe0HpECUDdKDqmV4_Jd0tZWjvldXnxcfHn02a6t7bVT_zq4dnClfeOzftQHjpZ85g6uz1iqeNJehS_b_eBaxbmm2jK7XE4-RN3fgnLirQpHmrSPjtSkAjoTGIxXwciZZuMI-8OG_Uw5pzpjN8r7g1L-jWl_v_kJAAD__xgxZgI) that retrieves alien technology--a claim the Pentagon has denied.

In hearings into UFOs on Wednesday, witnesses also spoke of flying anomalies that couldn't be explained and [of being stigmatized](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFzhCAUBOBfgx0OPlC8giKN3aVN6TzloSSc3AAnc_8-Y-p0O7NbfLNf9_mOPvhj-8QHmeLijGvxJ81Cc9Ac5AyNNY4ISDZkuuEmVD90Xdfsph8XeQOlcFjA9UojCdu7kUigtEovjTcgQAoNWtyk7kSrLQkHix1HpdECMiXI-hJT-x39UXZy4R1PSu0aH00weynPzOQHg4nBVGtt1yUfVPPVM5iuyGB6uch3wuSPja_x2BLlzF_45AV_CCu-M6-7zyXQEmKldI0cJTpW4hZPb_mWXnnd-aVlMDXJ2Gf1Ifg8aKbE9kAf_kjl_4d-AwAA__-C3WpI) when they brought such claims to the government's attention.

Congress is seeking a way to review all UFO claims, and the Senate has introduced legislation to set up a review board. Despite all the discussion, no one has produced any evidence of alien life or artifacts.

| | | Dear Reader, You’ve likely heard people say: “Money is the root of all evil.”But that’s a lie. The Apostle Paul actually states: “The **LOVE** of money is a root of all kinds of evil.” It’s the **LOVE** of money that’s evil. Greed leads to lying, cheating and stealing to fill an endless appetite for more. This also leads one to take on risky investments. “Greedy people try to get rich quick, but don’t realize they’re headed for poverty,” Solomon warns in Proverbs 28:22. But there’s another type of financial sin that’s even more dangerous, and more common. And odds are, you’re committing this sin ... as it’s masked as being “conservative” and “smart.” It’s the love of money that is so great, one does not dare risk losing any of it. They hoard it. They stuff it in a bank account, a CD, gold or some other safe asset. And yes, that’s a sin. If that sounds harsh, don’t get mad at me. Get mad at Jesus. In the parable of the talents (Matthew 25), the master entrusts his three servants with his money. After a long time, when the master returns, the man who got five talents (a lot of money) created five more through his investments. The one who got two, created two more. The master rewarded these men by entrusting them with even more, saying: “Well done, good and faithful servant.”
But the servant who got one talent was afraid and buried it. He told his master: “I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here’s what belongs to you.” The master scorned the saver, saying: “You wicked and lazy servant!” He took the one talent and gave it to the others. So, let me ask you: Are you that third servant? Are you afraid of losing the money God has entrusted to you? Have you “buried” it? Yes, you should give some away through tithes and offerings.And God clearly states, “Test me with this, and see if I will not throw open to floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room to store it.” (Malachi 3:10.) But donations can only go so far. I believe, like the servants in the parable, we are called to invest God’s money. We really need to think about how we can change the world by investing in the right businesses. In a new interview, former Governor Mike Huckabee reveals what he’s doing with the money God has entrusted to him. He calls it “a miracle,” and it’s already changed over 100,000 lives! **[Go here to watch the interview](http://trk.readactnews.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzNjUxNjA3IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjMyMDgtMTQ5N2FmYWNjZTY0NDg1ZGI2MTIxOTM0MWI0YTBjZjciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMCIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHJvLmJhbnlhbmhpbGwuY29tL20vMjIxOTkxMiJ9/INEru2IRD_QGyHzQMDM1OA) ** [](http://trk.readactnews.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiOTgzNjUxNjA3IiwicnEiOiIwMi1iMjMyMDgtMTQ5N2FmYWNjZTY0NDg1ZGI2MTIxOTM0MWI0YTBjZjciLCJwaCI6bnVsbCwibSI6ZmFsc2UsInVpIjoiMSIsInVuIjoiIiwidSI6Imh0dHBzOi8vcHJvLmJhbnlhbmhpbGwuY29tL20vMjIxOTkxMiJ9/HClTM2PeL4Qu4ppN9xE4Xg) One day, like the master in Jesus’ parable, God will return and He will want to know what you did with the money he entrusted you with. My hope is that he will say: “Well done, good and faithful servant.” Regards,Aaron MahlerManager, Premium Services, Banyan Hill Publishing

**Friend, I have terrible news to share: 1,101 manatees died in Florida in 2021 – the deadliest year for manatees in our entire history. And just last year, the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission reported another 800 manatee deaths statewide.**
**So what's behind this recent surge in manatee loss? Starvation due to loss of seagrass beds from pollution-fed algae blooms, an issue that is only exacerbated by pollution from cruise ships.**
Cruise ships contribute to the destruction of vital seagrass that are manatees' No. 1 source of nutrition. They sail close to the shore and dump polluted wastewater, churning up sand and contaminants that all contribute to endangering water quality and seagrass beds. **This leaves manatees suffocating from lack of oxygen in the water and at risk of starvation. So unless Big Cruise is stopped from destroying their habitats, these gentle creatures will continue to face severe threats to their survival.**
Friend, these sweet, slow-moving manatees don't deserve to die at the hands of Big Cruise companies. We can help them before it's too late, but we need you on our side to protect our waterways from toxic pollution and save this precious endangered species.
**But we can only do it with your urgent action today – and we still haven't heard your response to our official poll. So please, speak up now:**

name: Sarah Longwell
subject: Meet the Trump voters against nominating Trump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Accountability PAC Inc
body:
These are Trump voters. They supported him and his policies. But now, they’re ready for new leadership without all the baggage.
|
---
Friend, At times it feels like Donald Trump’s grasp on the Republican Party is unshakable. Let me share a secret: it isn’t. In my focus groups, I’ve heard Republicans–even two-time Trump voters–say one thing over and over: “Trump has too much baggage.” They worry that the indictments, impeachments, and midterm losses make him a fundamentally unsound candidate for 2024. Here’s another secret. We’ve spent months collecting the stories of Trump voters who are ready to move on to a new candidate. The project is called “Baggage-Free GOP,” and it launches today.
---
[ ](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/MWKzwmP96M2W1qb4j34nV57_W8tMMP_51v3j_N3Gk37V3q8_QV1-WJV7CgQKnW5_8GP-8hmT3XVxvLYz94sgcKW4_FLs05qQ5lyW5r0Ywz5hH0F0N6dGZKvQn2qrW86Mwkt3ShfkTW8fxMHK7dVXhpW6s9Tng8n7SsqVWZMJK92tnT3W97QXJM6636rJVNY6cX2RBbBLW4f6tZm66BrwfW3s-v0S1MMyJWW5577PX26lRFcVpZRB63qJVtxW2xMfsT60HVt5Vlmm4p8ZSC1KW5dJhxm5h4zNSW9dPYDX7_pp0xN9gSYsL607_hW4Vv2fs2HWWkMVrstFR1xLqJq35g71)
---
The sentiment we've heard people voicing is overwhelming:
* “Trump’s overall persona is not something that I can support any longer.” - Lu, IA
* “I definitely will not vote for President Trump in the primary.” - Patrick, SC
* “Former President Donald Trump has too much baggage ... it’s so toxic.” - Michael, PA

This is just a small peek at this project, and I’ll share more of its full scope in the coming days. In the meantime, visit [www.baggagefree.gop](https://cQ0qs04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/2L+113/cQ0qs04/MWKzwmP96M2W1qb4j34nV57_W8tMMP_51v3j_N3Gk37V3q8_QV1-WJV7CgD_ZW5PCjNf6md7RLW2q8N__6qdYWmW3lKVnV33yv6DW2rmByG7PzzYCW8r6gdN17vSkrW1w0KLw4C0dx-W3LD-WY1dQFWjW3DlL6w5ds_YxW3XYBPL9cq-X8W5vsThY4bJpX_W84nthY509RL_W7pk0S82zqH7pN13vfPljhn-hW4-BzDn8qNnX-V_fVj21sF44nW4q7DxW7Vm4WDW43k_VD6nD6KWW2-XRng88GRVzW2tnLq31Q1r44W4WWN8V1k9_CLW829H5k7nxGptN8dRzJlkgbKX388Y1) and check out more of these stories. | | Peter,

I've spoken a lot about health freedom and individual rights. But what exactly is "health freedom" and how has it been violated the past few years? It’s time to explore these critical topics and clarify to the general public. The triad of tyranny, big tech, big pharma and big government has colluded to make us less healthy, less free, and less safe. We need to be equipped and articulate why health freedom matters. Please stay vigilant and educated on this issue!

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen

By reporting on these policies before politicians can spin the story to fit their agenda, we here at Shift WA offer our readers insight into what's really going on in their state. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62073960:W49OLxD7N:m:1:2610672541:7C1448071579D3EDDCF6C71C8545E7BE:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends, As the August Primary approaches, we wanted to remind you of the simple truth that elections matter - and so does what you read as elections approach. We here at Shift WA understand the importance of voters being well-informed about the policies that could shape our future. We value your trust in us to bring you that information.**It 's our goal to highlight details about politics in our state that voters will not get from mainstream media outlets, because that's the only way we can _shift_ the political debate in our Washington.** Over the years, we've shed light on critical policy developments long before mainstream news outlets bothered to report on them. Our work informing you about the problems with the Democrats' disastrous long-term care tax before its passage in 2020 is an example of our mission. We wrote about its flawed structure, and now we see its consequences, costing taxpayers significantly more than anticipated. Our early coverage of the Democrats' cap-and-tax scheme and their intentions to increase your gas costs was aimed at ensuring readers like you were aware of how such policies could affect your everyday life. From higher bills for heating your home to soaring gas prices at the pump, we warned about the potential impacts on your family's budget of Jay Inslee's green obsession. By reporting on these policies before politicians can spin the story to fit their agenda, we here at Shift WA offer our readers insight into what's really going on in the state. Our end-of-month deadline is fast approaching, and we are behind on our fundraising goal. **_[We need your support today](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62073961:W49OLxD7N:m:1:2610672541:7C1448071579D3EDDCF6C71C8545E7BE:r)_**. **_[Your contribution of $100, $50, or $25 will go a long way in making up the difference](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62073961:W49OLxD7N:m:1:2610672541:7C1448071579D3EDDCF6C71C8545E7BE:r)_**. Will you consider helping today? Thank you, The Shift WA Team | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62073962:W49OLxD7N:m:1:2610672541:7C1448071579D3EDDCF6C71C8545E7BE:r)
---

### SWVA FREE DENTAL CLINIC

People living in or near Southwest Virginia can take advantage of free oral care on July 28-29 as the Mission of Mercy dental clinic returns to UVA-Wise's Convocation Center.
Dental clinic hours will take place on Friday and Saturday from 7 am - 5 pm. Patients are encouraged to arrive early. Attendees are encouraged to wear comfortable clothes and to bring food and drink for the day. However, no overnight parking on the UVa-Wise campus will be allowed.
Call (804) 620-4032 for more information.

### Crystal Spring Pump Station - July 29 - Sept. 3
---
Crystal Spring Pump Station, site of Roanoke's oldest drinking water source, is a National Register of Historic Places listed building, and home to the last operational Snow Steam Pump in the United States.
Visitors can view the water in the spring box, learn about the microfiltration process, and see how Crystal Spring play a role in Roanoke's early history and development.
The Pump Station is open to the public weekends during the summer until Labor Day. Saturdays from 12 - 4 pm. Sundays from 1 - 4 pm.
Admission is free.

Dental clinic hours will take place on Friday and Saturday from 7 am - 5 pm. Patients are encouraged to arrive early. name: Alan Dershowitz
subject: The Sun's re-emergence is a gift...
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsZlsAxDNl

In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced
first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad
journalism....

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osZlsAxDNl

FROM THE
DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ

Dear
friend,

In over
sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand
the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism - mostly
the latter - and just how important and rare it is to get things
right.

In
today's media landscape there are far too many publications that
get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political
implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New
York Sun is different. It's a paper that places principle over
politics and people over party.

Its
in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President
Trump serve as a case in point.

When I
defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an
avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to
fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's
deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky
and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the
Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be
first rate.

It will
be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can
be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that
its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments
in American journalism.

I've been
impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an
uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun's
success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of
truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage
you to join the Sun today.

Join the
Sun Now →

Every
person matters in this effort.

Don't
wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Alan
Dershowitz

Columnist, The New York Sun

subject: 2024 is the time to put up or shut up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I will never stop standing up for what I know is right—even when it goes against the grain of public opinion.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpjbvkq4g8mrjs3p7u15s95tkfeg6hbjthpb4vi0_rp22sh2s8i66p70c5jmaob6c1h2bs)

Friend, **The time for chirping from the sidelines is over.** Talk is ineffective, and that's why my message has been simple: **2024 is the time to put up or shut up**. As a leader, your job is to put the interests of the people you serve above your own political gain. I've done that in Florida, and I've watched the American people cry out for real leadership nationwide. I will never stop standing up for what I know is right--even when it goes against the grain of public opinion. The American people deserve a President with a track record of taking action and standing for what's right. The lack of action from our leaders across this country has gone on for far too long. Joe Biden has done more to damage our nation than anyone, and Kamala Harris has done nothing at all. I am DONE hearing excuses. If Republicans want to ditch the culture of losing, then it's time we try something new. In Florida, I showed the country the playbook for defeating the woke mob:
* Giving parents back their voice in the classroom by BANNING CRT and pornographic content for young kids

* STANDING UP against woke corporations who have tried to force taxpayers to fund an ESG agenda

* DEFEATING Faucism and giving back Floridians the freedom to breathe and see their families after the elites in DC shut down the country

I'm tired of seeing Republicans lose. _A_ _ren 't you, Friend_ _?_ I promise you, with me as your candidate and President, Republicans will forget this culture of losing once and for all. To make sure we're able to achieve this, I am asking for your continued support. **[If you can, will you pitch in?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zak30u99ivi6g8rgmjc8r3eu9g2mooevilsvflu8_rp22sh2s8i66p70c5jmaob6c1h2bs "If you can, will you pitch in?")**

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhrjoqetfopv5q2fgmtbcmpu40a8dk7b2bcq98h8_rp22sh2s8i66p70c5jmaob6c1h2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

body:

| | |
# Campaign News and Views
What a MONUMENTAL month for the Binkley campaign! We are one step closer to the debate stage! Stay tuned for special updates and ways YOU can help get Ryan to the FIRST debate.
---
|
---
|
#### **Campaign Milestones**
---
| It has been a month to remember for the Binkley 2024 Campaign. From Meet and Greets to our first national polling milestone....and a successful weekend at Turning Point Action...the Binkley Campaign is well underway!

---
| |
---
### National Polling
Ryan Binkley polls **1% in the latest Harvard Caps Harris Poll**. This is an incredible milestone, as it is one of the requirements to get onto the first debate stage.

_Click[here](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=f9d3168458&e=c1403f41d3) for the full poll._
---
| |
---
### Turning Point Action
Ryan spoke at the Turning Point Action Conference in West Palm Beach, FL. along with other candidates and political activists. Binkley shared his heart of faith and freedom for the nation!

_Click[here](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=0b30a60c56&e=c1403f41d3) for full TPAction speech._
---
| |
---
### Interviews and Media
Ryan was featured on "The Blaze" network discussing important topics of today as well as an interview with David Brody on CBN News.

_Click[here](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=a7ba5ae4ab&e=c1403f41d3) for more from Ryan's CBN Interview._
---
| |
---
### Iowa Ground Work
The Binkley Campaign team is covering ground in Iowa! July was filled with several parades and connecting with Iowans at events and town halls meetings. So far, Ryan has covered the following:
---
|
---
• Dozens of events in Iowa and around the country
• Close to hitting 50 counties of 99
• Sold out a movie theater for _Sound of Freedom_ and met with crisis centers in Des Moines who assist with victims of abuse and human trafficking
• Met with Hope Ministry who feed thousands of people in the DSM metro each week
• Served veterans beverages at a VFW fundraiser
• Hosted a Dallas County BBQ
• Walked in several parades – West Des Moines is a LONG parade – _Don’t Stop Believing_ is our theme song
• Ryan played a great round of golf with Polk County republican activists
• Spoke to hundreds at the Lee County Republican Banquet
---
| _**Coming Up...**_
---
|
---
| |
---
### Iowa Lincoln Dinner
Stay tuned to hear more from the Iowa Lincoln Dinner coming up Friday, July 28th. Ryan will be speaking with fellow candidates on their message for the country.
---
| |
---
### Fair-Side Chats with Gov. Kim Reynolds
Mark you calendar for August 15th at the Iowa State Fair! Ryan will be joining Governor Kim Reynolds for her "Fair-Side Chats" as she interviews presidential candidates. If you're in Iowa, come out with your friends and family to support Ryan!
---
| **How Can I Help?** • _**LIKE AND COMMENT**_ on all social media posts
• A simple "I support Ryan Binkley for President" goes a long way!
• Ignore any argumentative comments that may follow
• Lastly, _**DONATE & SHARE**_ the link with everyone you know! We need 200 donors in 20 states as a part of another requirement of our 40k donors!

---
| **We need 40,000 unique donors to make it to the first debate stage, and we are currently nearing the 4,000 donor mark! **

**We are asking anyone who sees this message to take one moment to donate just one dollar and send the link to 10 new people to reach our goal. BE THE DIFFERENCE in allowing this message reach the nation!**

| | Friend, The campaign to Save Virginia and Save America continued this past week with an interview with Joe Thomas on WCHV (Charlottesville, VA); a meeting with law enforcement and localleaders at the “Honoring our Heroes” event in Waynesboro, Virginia; an interview on the Wilkow Majority on Sirius XM Radio; an interview on the Jeff Katz Show on WRVA (Richmond,VA); a presentation before the Hampton GOP in Hampton, Virginia; an interview on the Chris Stigall Show in Philadelphia, PA; an interview on Frank Gaffney’s Securing America TV; aninterview on the Robert Scott Bell Show; an interview on the Mike Van Meter Show along with a campaign endorsement for Mike who is running for the state senate in District 33; an interview on TNT Radio’s The Power Hour with Dave Krieger; an interview on The Absolute Truth Show on Frank TV with Emerald Robinson; a presentation at the Arlington GOP Picnic in Arlington, Virginia; and a presentation at the Liberty Republican Women’s Club BBQ at Frying Pan Park in Herndon, Virginia.

| | On July 17, I had the privilege of appearing on WCHV in Charlottesville with host Joe Thomas. We spoke concerning Senator Tim Kaine’s misguided attempt to change Senate rules in an effort to protect a new Biden Administration military rule that violates existing federal law and the Constitution’s separation of powers by paying servicemen’s travel expenses to have abortions in states where abortion is legal.
---
| | On July 17, I also had the privilege of meeting with First Responders at a wonderful event in Waynesboro, Virginia. I was pleased to meet many outstanding policemen and firemen whoput their lives on the line every day to protect and serve. I appreciate the support they are giving to our campaign across the state. Many expressed their support for our Back the BlueInitiative. Read my latest press release: ["Back the Blue Legislative Outline."](https://www.emordforva.com/so/e6OcJBAWm/c?w=bC-GdTTEE6ciZUBbFZz96KMHfFqmM1Unqg_-mcqOFOg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9mb3g0MC5jb20vYnVzaW5lc3MvcHJlc3MtcmVsZWFzZXMvZWluLXByZXNzd2lyZS82NDU0MDA2MDYvcHJlc3MtcmVsZWFzZS1iYWNrLXRoZS1ibHVlLWxlZ2lzbGF0aXZlLW91dGxpbmUiLCJyIjoiZDgzY2ZhMjEtYWNlYi00MDEwLWIxYjctZGEzOTE1MTAzMDhlIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiODEwMDFlZjItMTg5MS00MGYwLWJmN2QtYjJhNmM2ZjVjZWUyIn0)

| | |

| | On July 18, I appeared on the Jeff Katz Show in Richmond (WRVA) to discuss a wide range of issues. The host explained that we were the frontrunner in the U.S. Senate race and applauded our campaign to restore constitutional governance and the rule of law and end transitioning of youth, the socialist resurgence, and the woke agenda in the schools and military. On July 19, I appeared on the nationally syndicated Chris Stigall Show out of Philadelphia. As we discussed the lack of an evidentiary foundation to justify the prosecution of Donald Trumpin association with the events of January 6, 2020 at the Capitol, Chris made clear his strong support for our senatorial campaign. On July 19, I appeared on Frank Gaffney’s Securing America TV program. We discussed my recent Townhall.com article on the China threat. I explained the threat to individualliberty and sovereignty posed by the CCP's undue influence over, and CCP agent leadership in, international organizations, among them the WHO and the UN, are threatening individual freedom of choice with promotion of centralized digital banking currencies, centralized international control over emergency medical responses, and global digital identification. On July 20, I appeared on the Robert Scott Bell Show, as I do weekly, to discuss pressing national and international issues. I also appeared on Virginia State Senate Candidate Mike VanMeter’s Show. I endorsed Mike's candidacy. I spoke with him about issues of major concern in the Commonwealth: the transitioning of youth; Marxist CRT indoctrination in the schools; efforts to allow biological males to enter girls and women’s bathrooms, locker rooms, and sports teams; the flood of fentanyl killing over 2,000 Virginians annually; and the Soros-backed anti-incarceration prosecutors in Virginia who are keeping criminals on the streets and are responsible for the surge in violent crimes nationwide. On July 21, I appeared on TNT Radio’s the Power Hour with Dave Krieger. We discussed my Townhall.com article on the China threat as well as the politicization of the Department ofJustice and the FBI.

body:
This is what it looks like when the Left has seized full control of the justice system--and it’s NOT pretty...

| | | **ACTION CENTER** **Do you believe violent criminals should be released without bail after being apprehended by law enforcement?**
---
[>>> NO WAY <<<](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c663779%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=i6hysxnrhiztDPsEbREW6g&sysid=1)
---
| | Friend, Get ready for the crime wave to get a whole lot worse in Chicago... **Illinois sheriffs and prosecutors just lost their final legal challenge to the state’s unprecedented decision to eliminate cash bail.**
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c663770%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=61T6guTHKL%2bwXH10yN00GQ&sysid=1)
---
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c663771%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bwv4XlJ74qCPwsyTuCh7Wg&sysid=1)
---
Why is this so bad? Unless an exception is made, arrested and charged criminals will be allowed back on the streets immediately with a handshake and a “hope to see you at your trial!” Now the police will have to apprehend violent criminals TWICE, and the people of Illinois will be even less safe. This law was passed in the dead of night, conflicting with a provision in the Illinois constitution guaranteeing bail. But the Illinois Supreme Court is under Democrat control. The county judges and prosecutors who tried to stand up to this insane policy didn’t have a chance. **Friend, this is what it looks like when the far Left takes control of every branch of government -- ****_and they are trying to do it in EVERY state._** Whether it’s activist judges on state courts or radical prosecutors who refuse to prosecute crime, it all adds up to one thing: _law-abiding citizens are less safe than ever._ _[Fair Courts America](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c663770%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=61T6guTHKL%2bwXH10yN00GQ&sysid=1)_ exists to fight back against the radical takeover of America’s judiciary, at every level, in every state.
---

Our courageous witnesses fearlessly shared their UAP encounters, leaving no stone unturned (_aside from the ones that could not be said publicly due to legal hoopla_). Fravor's iconic ["tic tac" encounter](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ed719855ef2545be9f79f0a249ca182a&_e=JJDpzsXBSLhsmMK4JaEkAvnTIAqabdX3nSOZPZMIA1-5wHn1GAHiOwHBV6cU2CyWLtytxKPH5EUDNUamsaXIguONSeNCC2PPJBTJgYN-BQrnQfYyHfEdOG3cojoMtNBA4KIgbnMm3rgOqHzJ1vqfTyokvmbiJH9hWbZX1RXFj2yRXVCLBj3QulNYFetGaj_QCC5RNWl5KM6iYrHrQofJPW9czf4Xs-i-uZiRhHLlBjeZXy7ks4ZudBChRbg6FGfj), Graves' account of [dark gray cubes within a clear sphere](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ed719855ef2545be9f79f0a249ca182a&_e=JJDpzsXBSLhsmMK4JaEkAjs-qART8ocSTeDymcQjf8jfMmix1z9qtXI_u3A44-wKkHO7hfwB07TPo3rgcjV1ACb0Z_Q5cTeuc6U3v_A7V53dZUslBpzKBKpFHCBZ7VeFcMnxddviygiRyxH9kJr3fQBsn-aIlPrZMeJkX1lTXXG4P0LwE4p9GtcWhbJ_5UX8ZzeNnBfiW2vyAd8tDTTn30B9skZ1_bskWPhqSj0wAHCSFVT9r6VFbMVzlWJfyJIesxI0KvHgpXmjjbV24LBLH9xkzIuaCP0492MYMNGBmQ8%3D), and Grusch's admission of our possession of [nonhuman biologics](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ed719855ef2545be9f79f0a249ca182a&_e=JJDpzsXBSLhsmMK4JaEkAkRSeXjYcJssMBiQEmI64To_99gDe81mlfBkzF70gqn9cM-v--lnQHIoJjiMXMsPGeqtNENGAp5xCj2U11CL2kfA-e4wH4VowF8epO1Zd1wmAN3PkTANVJ-R_U6qzQ2_KAeYXK76s_x3di-N3Aoksw_PkL5dw6Kxfy6yz0NnwasDHM4OOmzl_ZJNPAHNFx34BPNifVKCMs70HCtOGrIaI8PGo3jhSzTrGLP5GvojzP-F) were just a handful of moments I was glad to get on the record. These men risked it all to [push for change](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ed719855ef2545be9f79f0a249ca182a&_e=JJDpzsXBSLhsmMK4JaEkAvnTIAqabdX3nSOZPZMIA19gxxld8yplrWeCw1uQrsHHgL3ETQr6n3DgfDu2QpFbkeZ9UBej5GFVPf_JiISF-vXv7ndAIkRyELKlPzf1QtrgrjxHvXrLLT2cnsA7AA8RDxt_ruPQ7VhIdW7nPh8bGIlsgTwr6WBS2hRRauWAG6C_OAI8fs2D8Hj882ZbflU9lQCxpxhQSgiHjyZ-FyXD1BiXYaFnEu1lW1jasewGMdYYyMKu9PiY_DUE2sC_BRpCtlgrEwQzOuuxFBOaB38gbwGuh99KhksvMEod5NazwCUh) on UAP matters, and their bravery should spur us into action. The [stigma](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=ed719855ef2545be9f79f0a249ca182a&_e=JJDpzsXBSLhsmMK4JaEkAt8R0uI1IkSfNp-rAIBnfnQdFIb-PYZ2THR26FJpjdqh87zMinG_0D7OL1xpfV2p58d2a-fI2qXtqZUKHzBB9l8FKdLlD3ieiIPOALl63rS09qrYdQyBhGlNfs-jFqbtdwUJ5T3QBbvf5_cWFdCN5fI7D4GGaEbCIY3Bz5FF7YAswE8R9PsMDZ-5DyWfeyEPFxOqPkAODiYNszJrxzHLnJ_NseB74cKh_X6ISkEhj1GMrlJCiTYtpkccE-31rx3iO_VKn4Oee_1ueHP-NZcdnOg%3D) around pilots trying to share their experiences is holding back real progress in understanding the worlds around us. But listen up, friend, there's a way forward. We got to prioritize open and honest investigations, making sure pilots have a safe space to report their encounters without fearing any naysaying backlash. No more games, no more hiding behind secrecy or lies—it's time we demand the government unleash the facts Americans deserve. By doing all that, we'll shine a bright light on UAP encounters and build a nation that's well-informed and engaged. Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After 13 years of advocacy, late nights, whipping votes, my legislation was finally passed in last year's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for your continued commitment to family rights and gender equity. With your support, I have spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, I'm proud to lead the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support.**

body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/bartonfordesoto/desoto-crime-lab-12613413?e=3c5d31b5ad)
Our nation has digressed into a crime-ridden state under liberal leadership at various levels of government. Open border policies at the national level allow a stream of illegal aliens, criminals, and drugs to infiltrate our country. Various cities have defunded our police and hamstrung our law enforcement officers so severely that crime runs rampant in their streets — our neighbor Memphis being one of those.

And at the local level, progressive, Democrat DA’s refuse to prosecute violent criminals, thieves and drug offenders. This unprecedented leniency toward criminals is threatening the safety and security of our communities, Mississippi, and our great nation. Tragically, it is allowing the darkest of crimes to grow—like child sex trafficking.

In 2021, Mississippi had the second-highest rate of human trafficking cases in the nation. That was 175 percent higher than the national average that year. This horrific industry runs rampant across the globe, but this high propensity makes it a state and local issue for us here at home. A new film released recently called “Sound of Freedom” focuses on the magnitude of child sex trafficking in the United States and around the world. The movie highlights the horrors of this trade and emphasizes the work that needs to be done to shut down this modern slavery industry.

While much is being done here in Mississippi to target human traffickers and stop the trade, more, larger-scale change needs to happen to keep children and families safe. A positive next step would be ousting liberal, progressive leaders at every level of government, and electing tough on crime conservatives whose records and priorities demonstrates a zero-tolerance rule against criminals of every kind — from drug dealers to serious, hardened criminals like child sex traffickers. Neglected priorities and liberal policies at the national level implores that we elect those among us who will not stand for threats, crime, or violence of any kind. If we want a local government that protects local people, we must elect conservatives who share our values.

As District Attorney, I will make human trafficking and stopping these criminals a priority by working together with Attorney General Lynn Fitch, our next sheriff, and the Department of Public Safety to protect our children from sexual predators. Nothing is more important than our children.
Learn more about my plan: bartonfordesoto.com (https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=http%3A%2F%2Fbartonfordesoto.com%2F%3Ffbclid%3DIwAR3pcAxtWjRbVI3UeW64JFeZDY69ZK_Oeei_AURnmQSekRUoSNx2-YCW7tk&h=AT2hT-4vLyujw-KUMzIJGou6f9kPKSJZ4tlfgpZEQfeI-0VUG8WLBB7Yihmtot3dEUwZingEE4GvQXO8lGztmZETEmKgNfrE7DNv_CX9qRQkwjeUPxq4SMmy8T_3gaoQU02NoGg-uzbfBjMrRWaOcHcU-w&__tn__=-UK-R&c[0]=AT3N9fGjOKgqtWIMk0MNGWKIYOAKgaoXxVBYmQpvy3qeM6NZnTls6H7MNB15Wsn-dci4zS93lnk3LeATeoKouKrvtCiQOBna2I_hSoWwk4SjtbSaqnWl-WGXy9StuT6xlqk4f6PGGtI4ZbJLiaEvZfJM9lo_59sPYTrfa_X0dArYCqC1CFUtJRjQW1hF2889_Tq8DQ)

Meet Matthew Barton

Matthew Barton grew up in Petal, Mississippi in a blue-collar family. His mother was a director at Tupperware and his father owned the small, family business – Barton Fence Company – where Matthew worked growing up.

After attending public school, Matthew attended Pearl River Community College and Warner University, where he studied Business Administration. He holds a law degree from Ole Miss Law, where he graduated Cum Laude and received the interviewing and counseling award.

In 2011, Matthew married his high school sweetheart, Megan. After graduating from Ole Miss Law in 2015, they moved to DeSoto County where Matthew started a law firm and Megan continued working at the Desoto County Schools as a Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant.

During law school, Matthew served as an intern in the DeSoto County District Attorney’s Office where he presented cases to grand jury, tried cases to verdict, and performed all functions of a practicing attorney. He has served as a prosecutor for the City of Southaven and the City of Horn Lake and now serves as a special prosecutor for Southaven, Horn Lake, and DeSoto County Justice Courts – where he’s established a strict, tough on crime reputation.

As an attorney, Mathew has dealt with every type of criminal matter ranging from DUI to capital murder, in more than 37 courts across Mississippi.

Matthew is a member of the Federalist Society, a conservative legal association, an enhanced conceal carry permit holder, Krewe of Hernando member, NRA member, and donates his time serving as a pro bono attorney to Veterans every year.

Today, Matthew, his wife Megan, and their daughter Eleanor live in Hernando where Matthew owns his private law firm. Eleanor attends Pre-K at Hernando United Methodist Church and Megan is a stay at home mom after seven years with DeSoto County schools.

subject: Joanna Weiss Attacks Dave Min for……not being a Democrat?
body:
California’s Largest Union and Liberal Scholar Erwin Chemerinsky Push Back On “Absurd” Negative Attack In The Huffington Post | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/39820b81562c/joanna-weiss-attacks-dave-min-fornot-being-a-democrat-15659376?e=7017cc100e)

| | **For Immediate Release:** July 27, 2023
**Contact:**[**press@davemin.com**](mailto:press@davemin.com) **ICYMI CA47: Joanna Weiss Attacks Dave Min for....not being a Democrat?** _California’s Largest Union and Liberal Scholar Erwin Chemerinsky Push Back On “Absurd” Negative Attack In The Huffington Post _
_Desperate Mudslinging Begins As Min Continues To Consolidate Democratic Field With Commanding Fundraising, Poll Numbers, and Endorsements_
**IRVINE, CA —** This morning, one of Dave Min’s primary opponents, first-time candidate and former corporate lawyer Joanna Weiss, attacked Democratic State Senator Dave Min in the [Huffington Post](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=2378184ce3&e=7017cc100e), suggesting that the former University of California Irvine (UCI) School of Law professor, former policy director at the Center of American Progress, and former policy counsel to Senator Chuck Schumer, was some sort of ‘closet Republican’ because he was a voluntary faculty advisor to a conservative student group– the same student group which had previously been advised by Erwin Chemerinsky, known as one of the country’s foremost liberal legal commentators– while he was a professor at UCI Law. Min, the current Democratic State Senator for California’s 37th District– which overlaps with over 80% of the 47th Congressional District where he is running– has twice been previously endorsed by the California Democratic Party, has an A+ rating from Planned Parenthood, 100% rating from NARAL, was named a “Labor Champion” by the California Labor Federation, and is running for California’s 47th Congressional District with the [endorsement](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=b06f329526&e=7017cc100e) of incumbent Congresswoman Katie Porter, and over 150 local and state Democratic leaders. Prior to joining the faculty of UCI Law in 2012, Min had a long and distinguished career fighting on behalf of progressive causes, highlights of which can be seen [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=efbd8b77e7&e=7017cc100e). Erwin Chemerinsky, who was the Dean of UCI Law when Senator Min was on the faculty there, and Oscar Lopez, the political director of SEIU, are among those who have issued statements defending Senator Min from this “absurd” attack from the Weiss campaign. _Erwin Chemerinsky, UC Berkeley School of Law Dean and founding Dean of UC Irvine School of Law:_
_“_** _When Dave Min joined the faculty of UC Irvine School of Law, he was a leading progressive voice on financial regulation and banking policy, and his progressive political leanings were well known to students and faculty alike._**__**_His role in advising the Federalist Society was consistent with the broader academic mission of promoting robust debate and free speech. In fact, Senator Min was following the example that I set, as I was the very first academic advisor to the Federalist Society at UCI Law. The implication that Dave Min was secretly a closet right winger is absurd and contradicted by the substantial weight of his entire career._**_” _ _Oscar Lopez, SEIU California State Political Director:_
_“_** _Joanna Weiss is trying to distract from the fact that she is self-funding her campaign with money earned from a career working against the labor movement and hard-working California workers. Dave Min’s progressive record speaks for itself_** _.”_ _Isabel Ocampo, Min Campaign Spokeswoman _
_“_** _100% Rating from Planned Parenthood. 100% Rating from NARAL. Former Policy Director for the Center for American Progress. Former Economic Policy Advisor for Senator Chuck Schumer. Endorsed by Congresswoman Katie Porter. Endorsed by the California Democratic Party in 2018 and 2020. State Senator Dave Min’s progressive record and accomplishments speak for themselves—the real question here is why his political opponent is resorting to these kinds of desperate negative attacks to distort Senator Min’s record in bad faith?_**_” _ **The negative campaigning comes on the heels of Min, continuing to expand his lead in**[**fundraising**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=f081fce96f&e=7017cc100e)**,**[**endorsements**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=3db4c32a7d&e=7017cc100e)**and **[**strong poll numbers**](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5c0096b552&e=7017cc100e)**.** Senator Min has substantially outpaced the Democratic field in terms of the most money raised to date, the most cash on hand, and the most money available for the primary election. He has over 160 key endorsements from federal, state, and local leaders and labor organizations. He won CA-47 during that election by over 5% in 2020, a tough year for Orange County Democrats, defeating a long-time Republican icon who was thought to be unbeatable. Just after the end of 2023’s first quarter, former Congressman Harley Rouda ended his bid for the 47th, leaving Min as the only Democrat in the race with previous campaign, legislative, or federal policy experience. **Senator Min, the only Korean-American in the state legislature,** serves as Chair of the Senate Natural Resources and Water Committee and as Senate Vice Chair of the Asian and Pacific Islander Legislative Caucus. Min has proven himself an incredibly effective legislative leader in the Senate, authoring 17 bills signed into law by the Governor, including leading legislation on climate rescue, hate crimes, gun violence prevention, family safety, and women’s reproductive rights. Before entering the State Senate, Min was a law professor at UC Irvine, where he taught and researched in the area of business law, and was seen as a leading expert in his field, testifying six times before Congress and regularly appearing on CNBC, CNN, MSNBC, and NPR. Senator Min has spent his career in public service, including working at the Securities and Exchange Commission and as a policy advisor for Senator Chuck Schumer. He resides with his wife Jane Stoever, a UC Irvine law professor who specializes in domestic violence and family law, and their three children, who all attend public school in Irvine. Dave is a native Californian, a product of California public schools who graduated from the Wharton School and Harvard Law School, and an Eagle Scout. _California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15%. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15%. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2023 Dave Min For Senate, All rights reserved. # Jack Heath, Host of
# Good Morning New Hampshire
---
In this episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Vikram Mansharamani speaks with Jack Heath, host of Good Morning New Hampshire. Jack shares lessons learned along the way from a sports-focused kid in Massachusetts to studying economics and politics at the University of Vermont and through his phenomenal career in journalism. In addition to being a TV anchorman and a radio show host, he's also a published novelist, accomplished entrepreneur, and former candidate for the US House of Representatives. Jack discusses how adversity and failure helped him grow and how uncertainty is an unavoidable aspect of life. His simple advice for navigating uncertainty: plan for the unexpected.
Tune in via the links below!

---
PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND!
For those who missed the prior episodes of NAVIGATING UNCERTAINTY, have no fear! They're all available on demand via the links below. As you sit in traffic during your weekend trips, tune in and use the opportunity to learn about some fascinating people as well as some of the most important topics of our times!
You'll find my conversations with John Formella, Attorney General of New Hampshire, Dean Kamen, Founder of DEKA Research, Donald Kreis, Consumer Advocate for the State of NH, Jeremy Hitchcock, Founder of Dyn and Executive Chairman of Minim, Phil Taub, Partner at NixonPeabody and Co-Founder of SWIM WITH A MISSION, Morgan Ortagus, Former Spokesperson for the State Department, David Jordan, Founder of Seven Hills Foundation, John Avlon, Senior Political Analyst at CNN, Derek Leathers, Chairman & CEO of Werner Enterprises, Rudy Glocker, Founder of Burgeon Outdoor, former US Senator Kelly Ayotte, NCUA Vice Chair Kyle Hauptman, Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, NH Governor Chris Sununu, NH Education Czar Frank Edelblut, Commissioner of Business and Economic Affairs Taylor Caswell, GOP Presidential Candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, former Commander of NORAD and Retired Four Star General Lori Robinson, and former Chair of House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence Mike Rogers.

Jack discusses how adversity and failure helped him grow and how uncertainty is an unavoidable aspect of life. His simple advice for navigating uncertainty: plan for the unexpected. Tune in via the links below! PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND! For those who missed the prior episodes of NAVIGATING UNCERTAINTY, have no fear! They're all available on demand via the links below. As you sit in traffic during your weekend trips, tune in and use the opportunity to learn about some fascinating people as well as some of the most important topics of our times! Fellow American, **Our nation needs _REVIVAL_.** These are dark and trying times for America, and now more than ever, we need to turn to our great God for peace... for hope... for victory. That's why TPUSA Faith has launched our **Kingdom to the Capitol Tour** \-- a series of live worship events in ALL FIFTY STATE CAPITALS designed to ignite the flame of REVIVAL in bible-believing Americans across the country! **And, after reaching THOUSANDS with the Gospel and REVIVAL, we are in the FINAL WEEKS of our 2023 tour ... and we'll be roll through the final states in 2024.** [**Will you help TPUSA Faith finish our FINAL EVENTS for the Kingdom to Capitol Tour this year, with your generous gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, or more to help us reach as many people as possible before September 1?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
---
[**GIVE NOW >>**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-rJvFv0CpaQ)
---
So far, **Kingdom to the Capitol** has visited almost half of America's capitals. We only have two more weekends, where we will visit six states to finish out this summer. We plan to roll through the rest of America in 2024. Your generous partnership will enable us to promote these powerful worship events far and wide in our upcoming cities ... to fill local church buildings with worshipers ... and to send an army of believers back into their communities with renewed hope and power to bring revival to our nation when it's needed most. Whether it's the spread of socialism, gender ideology in public schools, the scourge of abortion, or the recent tragic shooting at a Nashville Christian school, you don't have to look hard to see the darkness plaguing our country when it drifts from the truth of scripture. But followers of Jesus know the promises that the Lord has made to the nation that turns back to him. We know that he is gracious to forgive us, and to lavish his mercy and blessings on his people. And that's exactly what we're pleading with the Lord to grant as we seek His face in worship at these powerful events. [**But we can't do it without you. Will you please make your generous and much-needed gift right now?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-5ouDt_5q4g) Together, we can make these the first of many thousands to have their hearts and lives invigorated by these powerful worship events. [**Your generous gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, or whatever the Lord leads you to give will enable us to bring hundreds more people to our Kingdom to the Capitol worship events -- until we've hosted one in EVERY state capital in America!**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

After reaching THOUSANDS with the Gospel and REVIVAL this summer, we want to reach THOUSANDS more. These important events, empowered by the Holy Spirit and made possible by your generous partnership, are bringing the hope of the Gospel to every state capital in America. These are desperate times for our nation. Now is the time to bring God's kingdom near. That's exactly what TPUSA Faith is doing with our Kingdom to the Capitol Tour. [**Will you please pray and give today to help move this mission forward for the glory of God, for the good of America, and for the good of our world?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-Cwrr_uNWMyP67XbQhJ-g) Just imagine the national revival that our great God could begin through us! God bless you,

Lucas Kunce

**ICYMI: Chris Christie Calls For Special Counsel To Investigate Biden Family**
On Wednesday, Governor Chris Christie called for a competent and independent investigation into the Hunter Biden case:
[_**CHRIS CHRISTIE**_](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=97a375ba30&e=d0a9afa930) _**: “I’ve seen enough. Get rid of US Attorney Weiss & appoint a special counsel who will investigate with competence and independence.”**_

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

_**Doctor’s Office Care at Hospital Prices**_ By Bobby Jindal and Charlie Katebi
---
_Consolidation of medical practices brings dishonest billing that costs patients and taxpayers billions._
---
Each year, millions of patients visit their doctors’ offices for a variety of routine services. But in recent years, more Americans are being charged as if they had visited a hospital. And it is because the doctor’s office billing them is, in fact, pretending to be a hospital. When a hospital bills a patient’s insurer, it must report a federally required National Provider Identifier number on the claim form to identify where the care took place. Many hospitals use the same NPI number for care that happens at a doctor’s office or the main hospital, allowing hospitals to add a facility fee and charge far more than they would for a doctor’s visit. **[FINISH READING ON WSJ.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=b6daddb47a754bdc88884775133630af&_e=CvyDHJoS2ftXBvpS4lee6KHttOy3JnZXhZ7YGch3lazfL-3dLkh3-2q2r0Vuy6Wy0CscSlFw3Op1H4mkPt2HgBZMK38tNL44d1gV-cEa2GnrRxTKJFRlh7K4OXit0okXkX6NmaTruWCtWqXFWeIAV0TWs0iIRgMk9kg3pJMePfkkV_Fx4jbu-ZatR5pqB2YHtkmOOrrTBatVgSO9rB-caDa3xs0lqtb06xwz5vvf1WcVfvxRgDIi3pzpZM-Je3uzR7Wn7muaYOT9kThpU2rzwGeAR3yT5fjQ8BqnbuCq2d_w70B5jwoSb-1nBmV43nV75duwjLnQc9aKAfTSK4pfJg%3D%3D)**

# [Add your name: Tell Congress to censure Marjorie Taylor Greene](https://default.salsalabs.org/T058a7f36-93f7-4176-8ea7-4793c091c254/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
