---
| | | A Democratic Representative in the House has just introduced a resolution [to censure](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf6e9530b-5793-4064-8fb6-8f2cc323d1c4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) conspiracy theorist and Trump fanatic Marjorie Taylor Greene for a laundry list of more than 40 horrible things she’s said and done – including displaying explicit sexual images of Hunter Biden during a Congressional hearing, something even her fellow Republicans were appalled by. [Add your name, and tell Congress to pass it and censure her >> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T025e1b4d-fb98-4e99-9be2-2b9d810a5e29/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) We’ve had enough of Marjorie Taylor Greene’s antics – from calling House members the “Jihad squad” to spreading baseless lies about the 2020 election, to advocating for states to secede from the US and more, she has no place in the halls of Congress. Ultimately we’d love to see Greene expelled from Congress altogether, but censuring would be a good start to finally holding her accountable for her despicable words and actions. And it would force Republicans to go on record supporting her – including vulnerable ones in swing districts. [Add your name: Demand Congress censure Marjorie Taylor Greene >> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T43bb1f3c-8f6f-42f9-b699-683b8c7a62bf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party. Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point. When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments. The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate. It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism. I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join. The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today. Every person matters in this effort. Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now. | | | | | Alan Dershowitz Columnist, The New York Sun | | | | | | | | | |

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
Pulling back the curtain to share a day in the life!

Hey, Peter – Ever wondered what running for governor looks like in the day-to-day? Well, today, I’m throwing back the curtain — **here’s what a single day running for governor looks like.** **_[Before I dive in, I could really use your help to hit our end-of-month online fundraising goal before the deadline. Please, chip in $5 to help me travel the state as much as possible and reach as many voters as possible before Election Day.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67133650/418740278/368366008?amount=5&refcode=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ms=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzOTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTkwYmZhMDQtOWYyYy1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9KG8k5dVPD9dwT0WspkMT_9gBJMu6V0bT8Vt-kFZKUg=)_**
* * *
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67133652/418740280/368366008?refcode=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ms=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzOTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTkwYmZhMDQtOWYyYy1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9KG8k5dVPD9dwT0WspkMT_9gBJMu6V0bT8Vt-kFZKUg=)
We started early with a coffee visit in Tallulah with Charlie Butler, the Madison Parish School Superintendent. We talked about teacher pay, retention, and certification, the importance of the MFP, the critical role of parents & more. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67133655/418740283/368366008?refcode=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ms=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzOTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTkwYmZhMDQtOWYyYy1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9KG8k5dVPD9dwT0WspkMT_9gBJMu6V0bT8Vt-kFZKUg=)
Later that morning, East Carroll Sheriff Wydette Williams gave me a great tour of Lake Providence, a community I have been visiting since 1998. We discussed rural development with education leaders, the Port Director, and the Hospital Administrator. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67133662/418740315/368366008?refcode=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ms=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzOTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTkwYmZhMDQtOWYyYy1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9KG8k5dVPD9dwT0WspkMT_9gBJMu6V0bT8Vt-kFZKUg=)
While in Lake Providence, I visited with Mayor Bobby Amacker and property manager Ranata Johnson, who gave me a tour of the impressive quality affordable housing available. This is another successful Louisiana Housing Corporation development. We need more of this to grow rural communities. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67133666/418740361/368366008?refcode=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ms=ea.590bfa04-9f2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzOTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTkwYmZhMDQtOWYyYy1lZTExLWI4ZjAtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9KG8k5dVPD9dwT0WspkMT_9gBJMu6V0bT8Vt-kFZKUg=)
I concluded the evening in LaSalle Parish. Thank you to Pastor Chauncey Hardy, School Board member Melvin Worthington and Police Juror Casey Jones for joining me.
* * *
Peter, I’m putting in long campaign days like this one because I believe Louisiana’s best days are ahead of us, not behind us — _but only if we work towards it together._ **That’s why I’m counting on you to help hit our end-of-month online fundraising goal.** Every dollar we receive helps us to reach more voters and keep our ads running, and missing our goal will mean cutting back these essential expenses. **_[So please, chip in anything you can to help hit our goal before the deadline and fuel this campaign with the resources we need to July 27, 2023
Dear friend,
If we are to build the city and state we all want to see, a lot is riding on the 2023 municipal elections happening all across Tennessee. That means it’s more important now than ever that we get behind and support great candidates.
That’s why Tennessee Voter Project is getting behind candidates, like Attorney Jerri Green who is running for Memphis City Council District 2 (Cordova and East Memphis).
In fact, we’re hosting a Yard Sign Pickup Party for Jerri on Thursday, August 3, from 5:30 to 7pm and you can RSVP for the event by clicking here [bit.ly/tvpgreenparty] .
Jerri is a life-long Memphian who has advocated on behalf of the most vulnerable for decades. She has served as the Executive Director for Community Legal Center in Memphis, an organization that bridges the justice gap and helps immigrant and refugee families navigate the legal system to settle safely in the United States. And right now, she’s an attorney and Senior Policy Advisor in Shelby County Government, where she has led countless programs, including starting with Shelby County’s Free Gun Lock by Mail program.

Finally, we are so grateful for all of you who have supported TVP in the past and helped us screen and identify progressive candidates across our state. body:
Reporter Kyle Kaminski recently published the results of an extensive investigation into attempts by Donald Trump’s insurrectionists to overturn Michigan’s 2020 election results.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1293%2E120351%2EYJFted)
Peter, at Courier Newsroom our mission is to deliver important and relevant local news stories to communities that need them most. We pay close attention to stories involving misinformation — especially when it comes to our elections.
There’s no better example of this kind of high-quality journalism than this recent piece from our Michigan newsroom, _The Gander_. Reporter Kyle Kaminski recently published the results of an extensive investigation into attempts by Donald Trump’s insurrectionists to overturn Michigan’s 2020 election results. **What he found will be concerning for Michiganders and all Americans.**
[**Make sure to read Kyle’s reporting below, and if you want to support more high-quality journalism like this, then pitch in $5 or whatever you can to help us run newsrooms in 8 battleground states across the country.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230727?refcode=em20230727&amount=5&refcode2=1293_120351_YJFted&akid=1293%2E120351%2EYJFted)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230727?refcode=em20230727&amount=5&refcode2=1293_120351_YJFted&akid=1293%2E120351%2EYJFted)**
– The Courier Newsroom Team
* * *
[](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/3765?t=2&akid=1293%2E120351%2EYJFted)
Written By Kyle Kaminski for _The Gander_
Originally Published July 19, 2023
LANSING—About three weeks before a violent mob of armed insurrectionists stormed the US Capitol over a so-called “stolen” election, Republicans in Michigan were allegedly back home cooking up their own scheme to subvert democracy and keep then-President Donald Trump in office.
Two and a half years later, 16 of those Michigan Republicans are now facing felony charges filed this week by Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel. If convicted, the accused could spend more than a decade in prison for their alleged misdeeds.
**Here’s the Deal:**
On Dec. 14, 2020, a group of 16 Michigan Republicans allegedly had a secret meeting in the basement of the Michigan Republican Party headquarters in Lansing, where they signed their names to multiple certificates falsely stating they were the state’s “duly elected and qualified electors for for the president and vice president of the United States,” according to Nessel.
There’s only two problems: Trump did not win the election, and these were not the real electors.
Michigan’s presidential electors—who were constitutionally obligated to cast their votes for Joe Biden because he won the election by 7 million votes nationwide, including a clear popular vote majority in Michigan—had met that same afternoon inside the state Capitol to fulfill their duty to voters.
But by then, the scheme from the fake Republican electors was already in motion.
Prosecutors said their false documents were sent on to the US Senate and the National Archives in what Nessel’s office described as a “coordinated effort to award the state’s electoral votes to the candidate of their choosing, in place of the candidates actually elected by the people.”
The “desperate plan,” as Nessel called it in a statement this week, failed—miserably.
Biden was sworn in as president a month later, and every serious challenge to the 2020 election since has been denied, dismissed, or otherwise rejected as a conspiracy theory or outright lie.
And now the Republicans who allegedly orchestrated the plan could face steep consequences.
In all, Nessel filed 128 separate criminal charges—including forgery and conspiracy to commit election forgery—against 16 people. The charges could send each of the defendants to prison for up to 14 years.
“The evidence will demonstrate there was no legal authority for the false electors to purport to act as ‘duly elected presidential electors’ and execute the false electoral documents,” Nessel said in a statement announcing the criminal charges on Tuesday afternoon. “There was no legitimate legal avenue or plausible use of such a document or an alternative slate of electors.”
**Who are the Fake Electors?**
The group of Republicans who falsely posed as presidential electors includes the head of the Republican National Committee’s chapter in Michigan, **Kathy Berden** ; Wyoming Mayor **Kent Vanderwood** ; Shelby Township Clerk **Stan Grot** , as well as the former co-chair of the Michigan Republican Party, **Meshawn Maddock** , the wife of state Rep. Matt Maddock (R-Milford).
Maddock, 55, helped organize buses to travel to DC on the day of the insurrection, and has repeatedly referred to her work with election and campaign volunteers as “training an army.” She and her husband also reportedly told the armed insurrectionists: “We never stop fighting.”
Former Michigan GOP Chair Laura Cox has said that Maddock wanted to bring along a camera crew for the signing “ceremony” of the fake electors. Cox opposed the idea because she didn’t want the document viewed as a legitimate attempt to overturn Michigan’s electoral votes.
Many of the other fake electors charged this week have also maintained relatively prominent roles in Michigan politics, both within and outside of the state Republican Party, including:
**Marian Sheridan** , 69, was recently re-elected by delegates as grassroots vice chair of the state Republican Party. **Michele Lundgren** , 73, lost her state House campaign last year against state Rep. Abraham Aiyash (D-Hamtramck). **Amy Facchinello** , 55, is a school board member in Grand Blanc. **Hank Choate** , 72, is a Cement City farmer who’s well-known in agricultural circles, and was awarded as the Michigan Farm Bureau’s volunteer of the year last year.
**Mayra Rodriguez** , 64, was the secretary for state’s GOP electors and the only attorney among the 16 people who signed the fraudulent certificate, reports the Detroit News. Both Rodriguez and Berden, 70, also refused to cooperate with a committee that investigated the insurrection.
**Clifford Frost** , 75, ran unsuccessfully for state House in 2020 and works as a real estate agent. **John Haggard** , 82, is the owner of Haggard’s Plumbing and Heating in Charlevoix. **Mari-Ann Henry** , 65, is the treasurer for the 7th Congressional District GOP Committee. **Timothy King** , 56, along with Haggard and Sheridan, was a plaintiff in a failed lawsuit to overturn the election.
**James Renner** , 76, and **Ken Thompson** , 68, were reportedly acting as substitutes for those who missed the meeting where the false documents were signed. **Rose Rook** , 81, a retired real estate agent, is on the executive committee of the Van Buren County Republican Party.
Four of the defendants—Lundgren, Maddock, Sheridan, and Thompson—also reportedly appeared at the state Capitol to cast their fraudulent votes but were turned away by the State Police. The average age of the defendants is about 69.
**What are the Charges?**
Election experts say extremists who dispute the results of a valid election in which there has been no evidence of fraud or manipulation of voting systems pose a danger of interfering in future elections. They warn it could trigger chaos if they refuse to accept results they don’t like.
And that’s the reason why Nessel is throwing the book at these 16 Republicans this week. Just because the plan failed and democracy prevailed, it “does not erase the crimes,” she explained.
“The false electors’ actions undermined the public’s faith in the integrity of our elections and, we believe, also plainly violated the laws by which we administer our elections in Michigan,” Nessel said in a statement this week. “My department has prosecuted numerous cases of election law violations throughout my tenure, and it would be malfeasance of the greatest magnitude if my department failed to act here in the face of overwhelming evidence of an organized effort to circumvent the lawfully cast ballots of millions of Michigan voters in a presidential election.”
The 16 Republicans each face two charges of forgery, and one charge of uttering and publishing, conspiracy to commit forgery, and conspiracy to commit uttering and publishing. Those four felony charges each carry a maximum sentence of up to 14 years in prison. They also each face two counts of election law forgery and one count of conspiracy to commit election law forgery—a combination of felonies punishable by up to five years in prison.
In 2021, Nessel referred the issue to federal prosecutors, but it didn’t result in any criminal charges. In January, Nessel announced she had reopened her own investigation at the state level—telling CNN that there was an “overwhelming” amount of evidence to warrant charges against the 16 Republicans who had pretended to be Michigan’s electoral college delegates.
“Obviously this is part of a much bigger conspiracy,” she said at the time.
**What Happens Now?**
All 16 defendants are set to appear for arraignment hearings in Ingham County at a date provided to each by the court, according to Nessel’s office. Phone and email messages seeking comment from several of those charged were not immediately returned to the Associated Press.
Some of them—like Maddock and Haggard—have told other outlets that they didn’t believe they did anything wrong, labeling the recent criminal charges as a “personal vendetta” against them.
In six other battleground states, Trump supporters also signed certificates that falsely stated he won instead of Biden. The fake certificates were ignored, but the attempt has been subject to several investigations—including the House committee that investigated the insurrection.
Investigations are underway in some other states that submitted fake electors, but not all.
A Georgia prosecutor investigating possible illegal meddling in the 2020 election has agreed to immunity deals with at least eight fake electors. Arizona’s Democratic attorney general is in the very early stages of a probe. Nevada’s attorney general has said he won’t bring charges, while Wisconsin has no active investigation and the attorney general has deferred to the US Justice Department. There is no apparent investigation into the fake electors from Pennsylvania.
A group of other Trump allies in Michigan—including former GOP attorney general candidate Matthew DePerno—are also facing potential criminal charges related to attempts to bust open sensitive voting equipment after the 2020 election. A grand jury was convened in March at the request of a special prosecutor to consider indictments, according to court records.
_The Associated Press contributed to this coverage._

Matt Maddock (R-Milford). Maddock, 55, helped organize buses to travel to DC on the day of the insurrection, and has repeatedly referred to her work with election and campaign volunteers as “training an army.” She and her husband also reportedly told the armed insurrectionists: “We never stop fighting.” Former Michigan GOP Chair Laura Cox has said that Maddock wanted to bring along a camera crew for the signing “ceremony” of the fake electors. Cox opposed the idea because she didn’t want the document viewed as a legitimate attempt to overturn Michigan’s electoral votes. Many of the other fake electors charged this week have also maintained relatively prominent roles in Michigan politics, both within and outside of the state Republican Party, including: Marian Sheridan , 69, was recently re-elected by delegates as grassroots vice chair of the state Republican Party. Michele Lundgren , 73, lost her state House campaign last year against state Rep. Abraham Aiyash (D-Hamtramck). Amy Facchinello , 55, is a school board member in Grand Blanc. Hank Choate , 72, is a Cement City farmer who’s well-known in agricultural circles, and was awarded as the Michigan Farm Bureau’s volunteer of the year last year. Mayra Rodriguez , 64, was the secretary for state’s GOP electors and the only attorney among the 16 people who signed the fraudulent certificate, reports the Detroit News. Both Rodriguez and Berden, 70, also refused to cooperate with a committee that investigated the insurrection. Clifford Frost , 75, ran unsuccessfully for state House in 2020 and works as a real estate agent. John Haggard , 82, is the owner of Haggard’s Plumbing and Heating in Charlevoix. Mari-Ann Henry , 65, is the treasurer for the 7th Congressional District GOP Committee. Timothy King , 56, along with Haggard and Sheridan, was a plaintiff in a failed lawsuit to overturn the election. James Renner , 76, and Ken Thompson , 68, were reportedly acting as substitutes for those who missed the meeting where the false documents were signed. Rose Rook , 81, a retired real estate agent, is on the executive committee of the Van Buren County Republican Party. Four of the defendants—Lundgren, Maddock, Sheridan, and Thompson—also reportedly appeared at the state Capitol to cast their fraudulent votes but were turned away by the State Police. The average age of the defendants is about 69. What are the Charges? Election experts say extremists who dispute the results of a valid election in which there has been no evidence of fraud or manipulation of voting systems pose a danger of interfering in future elections. They warn it could trigger chaos if they refuse to accept results they don’t like. And that’s the reason why Nessel is throwing the book at these 16 Republicans this week. Just because the plan failed and democracy prevailed, it “does not erase the crimes,” she explained. “The false electors’ actions undermined the public’s faith in the integrity of our elections and, we believe, also plainly violated the laws by which we administer our elections in Michigan,” Nessel said in a statement this week. “My department has prosecuted numerous cases of election law violations throughout my tenure, and it would be malfeasance of the greatest magnitude if my department failed to act here in the face of overwhelming evidence of an organized effort to circumvent the lawfully cast ballots of millions of Michigan voters in a presidential election.” The 16 Republicans each face two charges of forgery, and one charge of uttering and publishing, conspiracy to commit forgery, and conspiracy to commit uttering and publishing. Those four felony charges each carry a maximum sentence of up to 14 years in prison. They also each face two counts of election law forgery and one count of conspiracy to commit election law forgery—a combination of felonies punishable by up to five years in prison. In 2021, Nessel referred the issue to federal prosecutors, but it didn’t result in any criminal charges. In January, Nessel announced she had reopened her own investigation at the state level—telling CNN that there was an “overwhelming” amount of evidence to warrant charges against the 16 Republicans who had pretended to be Michigan’s electoral college delegates. “Obviously this is part of a much bigger conspiracy,” she said at the time. What Happens Now? All 16 defendants are set to appear for arraignment hearings in Ingham County at a date provided to each by the court, according to Nessel’s office. Phone and email messages seeking comment from several of those charged were not immediately returned to the Associated Press. Some of them—like Maddock and Haggard—have told other outlets that they didn’t believe they did anything wrong, labeling the recent criminal charges as a “personal vendetta” against them. In six other battleground states, Trump supporters also signed certificates that falsely stated he won instead of Biden. The fake certificates were ignored, but the attempt has been subject to several investigations—including the House committee that investigated the insurrection. Investigations are underway in some other states that submitted fake electors, but not all. A Georgia prosecutor investigating possible illegal meddling in the 2020 election has agreed to immunity deals with at least eight fake electors. Arizona’s Democratic attorney general is in the very early stages of a probe. Nevada’s attorney general has said he won’t bring charges, while Wisconsin has no active investigation and the attorney general has deferred to the US Justice Department. There is no apparent investigation into the fake electors from Pennsylvania. A group of other Trump allies in Michigan—including former GOP attorney general candidate Matthew DePerno—are also facing potential criminal charges related to attempts to bust open sensitive voting equipment after the 2020 election. A grand jury was convened in March at the request of a special prosecutor to consider indictments, according to court records. The Associated Press contributed to this coverage. Friends,
All 11 of our state freedom caucuses have recently called on their respective states to sever ties with the marxist American Library Association (ALA). The Left will continue their ongoing cry that we're trying to ban books. No such thing is occurring and we refuse to let them distract the public away from their real agenda. The ALA is the backbone to our entire country's library system, and they are using that platform to indoctrinate our children with Critical Race Theory (CRT) and obscene materials, while censoring other perspectives that counter their Marxist agenda. They do this by training our librarians and buying Marxist books in bulk - **using our tax dollars** \- to then put into our libraries.
As we build a nationwide coalition to fight the ALA, we have partnered with our good friends at the [American Accountability Foundation](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4309e1f5-31e9-4a4e-825e-251282d1f707?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They are the preeminent organization in our country that does comprehensive opposition research into the Left's activities. They have done a deep dive into the ALA's efforts and we want to share that information with you today. Please read the following and then join us by supporting our state lawmakers in this much-needed fight against the woke Left.
* * *
**THE AMERICAN LIBRARY ASSOCIATION 's MARXIST AGENDA**
_by the American Accountability Foundation_
The American Library Association (ALA) has emerged as a focal point in the war against wokeness in libraries across the country. With a radical agenda and promotion of woke policies, the ALA has transformed libraries into hotbeds of political activism. The ALA represents one of the greatest threats to freedom and decency in our public libraries and defunding their operations would reduce their influence on young people.
By refocusing on learning and impartiality, libraries can return to their core mission of providing unbiased access to knowledge for all, fostering open discourse, and respecting the values of local communities. It is time to prioritize intellectual freedom and the well-being of our communities over the divisive ideologies that currently permeate some library spaces.
The preliminary research from the American Accountability Foundation demonstrates that the ALA has:
* Elected a self-proclaimed "Marxist lesbian" as its president.
* Awarded its James Madison Award to George Soros.
* Promoted drag queen story hours for children as young as toddlers.
* Promoted Critical Race Theory.
* Promoted sexual content to minors.
* Conspired to prevent Christians from holding events at public libraries.
* Supported radical and divisive diversity programs.
* Pushed highly inappropriate and sexualized reading lists at libraries.
* Pushed gender ideology content to minors.

If you want to read [AAF's full report](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f49ac355-80cd-44a8-9fa5-b481610d3b9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the American Library Association's Marxist, woke agenda, click [here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/f49ac355-80cd-44a8-9fa5-b481610d3b9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_

I’m fighting to make sure special interests, corporations, and the rich and powerful stop taking advantage of working people. My inspiration comes from the Americans who are demanding change and fighting for a better future for their families and communities. People like the nurses, teachers, actors, writers, baristas, and retail workers striking for better working conditions. The organizers working to protect abortion access at the state level with ballot initiatives. The millions of young people worldwide demanding action on climate change to ensure the survival of our planet. Their fights are my fights, and I'm working for the big, bold changes we need to see in this country. We need to pass a wealth tax to make the wealthy finally pay their fair share. We need to crack down on corporate profiteering and price gouging so that working families don’t pay the price for their greed. We need to end the filibuster to ensure abortion rights across the country. We need to increase the minimum wage and make it easier to join a union. **And — importantly — we need leaders willing to fight for this. Democrats win when we go out there and unapologetically fight for the big, structural change we need — not just a tiny fix here and a small update there. We need to stand up to powerful special interests and advocate for real change for working people. I’m not afraid to fight for this — and your support helps ensure we can campaign for our plans and win.** [**So if — and only if — you’re able, can you chip in whatever you can today to help power my re-election campaign and push this movement forward? clean_body: We need leaders willing to fight for these ideas. That’s how Democrats can win. | | | I’m fighting to make sure special interests, corporations, and the rich and powerful stop taking advantage of working people. My inspiration comes from the Americans who are demanding change and fighting for a better future for their families and communities. People like the nurses, teachers, actors, writers, baristas, and retail workers striking for better working conditions. The organizers working to protect abortion access at the state level with ballot initiatives. The millions of young people worldwide demanding action on climate change to ensure the survival of our planet. Their fights are my fights, and I'm working for the big, bold changes we need to see in this country. We need to pass a wealth tax to make the wealthy finally pay their fair share. We need to crack down on corporate profiteering and price gouging so that working families don’t pay the price for their greed. We need to end the filibuster to ensure abortion rights across the country. We need to increase the minimum wage and make it easier to join a union. And — importantly — we need leaders willing to fight for this. Democrats win when we go out there and unapologetically fight for the big, structural change we need — not just a tiny fix here and a small update there. We need to stand up to powerful special interests and advocate for real change for working people. I’m not afraid to fight for this — and your support helps ensure we can campaign for our plans and win. = Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren for Senate All content © 2023 Warren for Senate, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

| | Our party has the solutions to fix America's problems, my friend. ...But we've got a few obstacles in our way. One of the greatest issues facing conservatives today is:_**The**_ **_Republican_** _**Party needs a reboot.**_ So how do we reboot a party and get back to our timeless principles and limitless potential?
---
|
---
**First – The GOP needs to look like America.** When Republican candidates say, "Common sense solutions are for everybody," they need to mean it. That also means showing up to places that historically haven't voted for Republicans. We need to stop preaching to the choir and instead GROW the Party. Republicans have become experts at providing ideological reinforcement to like-minded people, but devastatingly, we have lost the ability to be persuasive with, or welcoming to folks who don't agree with us on every issue. **Second – We need to stop peddling conspiracy theories.** Whether it's about so-called stolen elections that led to the Capitol insurrection on January 6th, or false assumptions, misinformation, and disinformation about former or current GOP leaders, it's gotta stop. **Third – The GOP needs to expand our views on Family Values.** We need to update our historical views on religion, marriage, and family to match more current family molds. Whether that's a man, woman, and child; or a woman and child; or yes, two moms or two dads.
---
|
---
To be blunt... The Republican Party should stand as the party of freedom. Freedom means empowering people, not the government. **Freedom, opportunity, growth, and progress ←** these core principles are what the GOP should stand for. name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: We have a long list of enemies
body:
#
Peter,
The political establishment has attacked us from the very beginning because they’re terrified of our people-powered movement that is actually shifting political power in our country to the 99%.
**Imagine the Democratic Party without AOC, Jamaal Bowman, Summer Lee, or Cori Bush in Congress.**
We recruited each of these leaders to run and win, and we’re building the infrastructure for even more grassroots candidates to do the same, but there is a long list of groups with millions of dollars to spend against us including AIPAC, the Moderate PAC, and the DCCC.
So Peter, today we’re asking for your financial support to ensure we have the resources to sustain our work moving forward. Can we count on you?

The _American Dream and Promise Act_ was introduced on DACA’s 11th anniversary by a group of bipartisan lawmakers in the House to provide a pathway to citizenship for millions of undocumented people — including DACA recipients.
As DACA recipients face an uncertain future while courts seek to shut down the program, we’re encouraged to see Congress finally responding to this moment with the urgency it demands.
But DACA recipients aren’t the only ones facing uncertainty — _with millions more undocumented people living under the fear of detention and deportation._ Our work can’t stop here.
**That’s why United We Dream Action is taking action to secure a comprehensive, expansive pathway to citizenship for not only DACA recipients and TPS and DED holders, but ALL undocumented people.**
We know for a fact that Congress has the power to deliver after working together to introduce this bipartisan bill. Now, we need to keep up our advocacy work to secure an expansive, inclusive pathway to citizenship that leaves no one behind. Will you join us?

body:
The rugged beauty of the Oregon Coast needs to be protected.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67142009/418767432/553882890?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQxOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjI0ZGQ3NC1iMjJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=75RpcnBqB6tlvH4Tey8VVpPewm0x0JfFx2CYIkz9rqs=&emci=4364a368-802c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=c624dd74-b22c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=9636579)

| | Peter, As the weather heats up, I'm seeing more and more Oregonians head to our district's beaches. From Brookings to Lincoln City, I get to represent 250 miles of breathtaking coastlines. But they're more than just beautiful. **Our beaches provide places for children to learn and play; our ports are critical infrastructure for the movement of goods; and, between tourism and thriving commercial fishing — the Pacific is an indispensable pillar of our local economy. ** With so much relying on our oceans and coastlines, we have to ensure they're protected. That's why I'm working to protect our oceans as a member of the Oceans Caucus and on the House Committee on Natural Resources, which oversees policy on oceans, water, wildlife, and more. **Together, we can tackle our oceans' greatest threats, including:** **🚯 Microplastics:** Tiny particles of plastic are polluting our oceans, harming marine life, and entering our food chain. We can reduce plastic waste and promote more sustainable alternatives. **🌡️ Climate Change:** Rising temperatures are causing devastating impacts on our environment, including our oceans and coastlines. Coral bleaching, sea-level rise, and altered marine ecosystems are just a few of the consequences. We must take action to combat climate change and safeguard our marine habitats. **🌊 Ocean Acidification:** Excessive carbon dioxide emissions are making our oceans more acidic, threatening the survival of coral reefs, shellfish, and other marine organisms. By reducing carbon emissions we can protect these vulnerable ecosystems **🛢️Pollution:** Toxic chemicals, oil spills, and excessive nutrient runoff are wreaking havoc on marine ecosystems. This pollution, both from land- and sea-based activities, is suffocating our oceans. Better regulations and more sustainable practices will help protect marine life. ⚓ **Modernizing Ports** : Upgrading our ports is crucial for efficient maritime transport. By implementing greener technologies and sustainable practices, we can reduce pollution, protect marine life, and ensure the smooth flow of goods while minimizing ecological impact. **While we have recently passed bipartisan legislation that allocated billions towards coastal restoration, marine debris cleanup and prevention, port modernization, and pollution reduction, we must recognize that this is just the beginning.** The need for further action to safeguard our seas and raise awareness about the dire threats posed by climate change has reached a critical level. Ocean acidification, warming waters, marine debris, and pollution are menacing working families, our environment, and our economies. clean_body: The rugged beauty of the Oregon Coast needs to be protected. | | | | Peter, As the weather heats up, I'm seeing more and more Oregonians head to our district's beaches. From Brookings to Lincoln City, I get to represent 250 miles of breathtaking coastlines. But they're more than just beautiful. Our beaches provide places for children to learn and play; our ports are critical infrastructure for the movement of goods; and, between tourism and thriving commercial fishing — the Pacific is an indispensable pillar of our local economy. With so much relying on our oceans and coastlines, we have to ensure they're protected. That's why I'm working to protect our oceans as a member of the Oceans Caucus and on the House Committee on Natural Resources, which oversees policy on oceans, water, wildlife, and more. Together, we can tackle our oceans' greatest threats, including: 🚯 Microplastics: Tiny particles of plastic are polluting our oceans, harming marine life, and entering our food chain. We can reduce plastic waste and promote more sustainable alternatives. 🌡️ Climate Change: Rising temperatures are causing devastating impacts on our environment, including our oceans and coastlines. Coral bleaching, sea-level rise, and altered marine ecosystems are just a few of the consequences. We must take action to combat climate change and safeguard our marine habitats. 🌊 Ocean Acidification: Excessive carbon dioxide emissions are making our oceans more acidic, threatening the survival of coral reefs, shellfish, and other marine organisms. By reducing carbon emissions we can protect these vulnerable ecosystems 🛢️Pollution: Toxic chemicals, oil spills, and excessive nutrient runoff are wreaking havoc on marine ecosystems. This pollution, both from land- and sea-based activities, is suffocating our oceans. Better regulations and more sustainable practices will help protect marine life. ⚓ Modernizing Ports : Upgrading our ports is crucial for efficient maritime transport. By implementing greener technologies and sustainable practices, we can reduce pollution, protect marine life, and ensure the smooth flow of goods while minimizing ecological impact. While we have recently passed bipartisan legislation that allocated billions towards coastal restoration, marine debris cleanup and prevention, port modernization, and pollution reduction, we must recognize that this is just the beginning. The need for further action to safeguard our seas and raise awareness about the dire threats posed by climate change has reached a critical level. Ocean acidification, warming waters, marine debris, and pollution are menacing working families, our environment, and our economies. I implore you to join me in my ongoing efforts to champion our oceans and coastlines in Congress. = Your early support holds the power to make a profound difference in our world. body:
Since I’m new to the team, I want to take a moment to personally introduce myself.
# [](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/39?t=1&akid=69%2E1163%2EccVI5s)
Hey, it's Hanna! I'm the new Digital and Communications Director on Lateefah Simon's campaign for Congress.
Since I'm new to the team, I want to take a moment to personally introduce myself and tell you a little bit about my work for our campaign.
**[If you're in a rush and don't have time to read through this entire email, I totally understand, but I hope you'll consider making a contribution to support our movement now! Every contribution to our campaign directly supports our mission to bring Lateefah's bold, progressive leadership to Congress.](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/142?t=2&akid=69%2E1163%2EccVI5s)**
**[Donate $10 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230727?amount=10&refcode=em20230727&refcode2=69_1163_ccVI5s&akid=69%2E1163%2EccVI5s)**
Here's a little about me and my background:
* I was born and raised in the Bay Area 🌉
* I have my own deep history with this district -- my grandparents, my dad and all of my aunts and uncles grew up in CA-12 💜
* In college I was a English and Political Science double major 📚
* And I've alway been driven by a desire to help elect bold, progressive leaders (especially women!) running for office 🏃♀️

Besides my personal connections to CA-12 and the Bay Area, I was drawn to Lateefah Simon's campaign because of her life-long commitment to progressive change-making.
It's crystal clear from the second you meet Lateefah that she has what it takes to effect real change. But even more than that, her genuine passion and sincere kindness blew me away.
I knew I wanted to be a part of a campaign that had the momentum, the expertise, and the community commitment to go all the way and really make a change in our district -- **that's Lateefah.**
Lateefah has proven time and time again she is willing to fight for _us_ , no matter what it takes. That's why Lateefah and our entire campaign have rejected special interest, super PAC, and corporate PAC money. This campaign is for and by the people.
As Digital and Communications Director I spend a lot of my day writing -- speeches, talking points, and emails like this one. I love what I do (it's the best job in the world) because I get to spend time helping Lateefah shape and share her message -- a message that I believe in. It's a privilege to be a part of the movement Team Lateefah is building, and I'm so excited that this community includes you.
I hope I've helped pull back the curtain and shown you a bit more about the real people who power this campaign!
**[If you're in a place to give, a donation of any amount today will help power Team Lateefah's work, including mine! So, can I count on you to contribute?](https://act.lateefahsimon.com/go/142?t=3&akid=69%2E1163%2EccVI5s)**
**[Donate $10 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ls-em-20230727?amount=10&refcode=em20230727&refcode2=69_1163_ccVI5s&akid=69%2E1163%2EccVI5s)**
Thank you,
Hanna R.
Digital and Communications Director
Lateefah for Congress

The GOP filled the VA bill with culture war amendments.
#
Hey there Derek,
We reached out last week when the GOP filled the Defense bill with amendments pushing their radical social agenda amendments, turning the entire mechanism that we fund our Military with into another culture war.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Sick and vulnerable patients need to be sent medicine; not collection notices.
CONTRIBUTE FOR REFORM [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
As a dedicated advocate for universal healthcare and a candidate for the US Congress, I want to share a deeply personal story with you.
I've witnessed the devastating impact of not only illnesses like cancer but also the burden of medical debt that follows in its wake.
In 1994, my older brother, Stephen, fought a valiant battle against cancer. Before his diagnosis, he was a giant personality. As a single father, he raised an amazing daughter. He even once ran a marathon backwards. Stephen was a force to be reckoned with on the rugby field and a talented photographer.
I admired him.
But, cancer didn't care. He died at 42.
I've witnessed firsthand the financial strain cancer patients like him endure. It's heartbreaking every time — watching someone's beloved family member suffer both physically and emotionally, all-the-while grappling with mounting medical bills.
I needed to take action. So, throughout my career, I dedicated my life of service to vulnerable, low income patients like my brother. And, just last year, I drafted — and successfully passed — a resolution with the Michigan Democratic Party to address the pressing issue of medical debt.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
We must alleviate the financial burden on families and individuals, ensuring that they can focus on healing and recovery instead of worrying about bankruptcy.
Over 40% of cancer patients deplete their funds in just two years.
I am committed to fighting for a publicly financed, national, non-profit health insurance program, and wiping out medical debt. We must provide full coverage for medical expenses for all American citizens. Together, we can ensure that no family has to choose between their health and financial stability ever again. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
I want to be the first family physician in Congress to help pass comprehensive healthcare reform. We need a doctor in the House.
When elected, I will lead Congress on this issue.
I cannot achieve this alone. , I need your support [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] . By making a contribution to our campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] , you will help us reach more voters, raise awareness about the urgent need for healthcare reform, and provide hope to countless individuals burdened by medical debt.
Together, we can transform lives and build a healthier, more compassionate nation.
I know my brother would be proud of our efforts. It's for him, his family, and millions of cancer patients like him that our battle endures.
Join our fight.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for Congress
Northern Michigan and the UP
Proud Democrat, MI01

This is what I didn’t want to have to send you, Fellow American. I know how bad things are right now. People are struggling to afford rent, buy groceries, and fill up their tank at the gas pump.

I’ve been there. Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck. At 17 years old, I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

I didn’t grow up with millions in the bank, and a silver spoon in my mouth. My dad was an Army General and my mom a schoolteacher. My parents taught me the key to success, **work**. And working is what I’ve been doing since I was 17.

Congress is in desperate need of someone to come in and shake things up – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. _Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices._

| | As a dedicated advocate for universal healthcare and a candidate for the US Congress, I want to share a deeply personal story with you. I've witnessed the devastating impact of not only illnesses like cancer but also the burden of medical debt that follows in its wake. In 1994, my older brother, Stephen, fought a valiant battle against cancer. Before his diagnosis, he was a giant personality. As a single father, he raised an amazing daughter. He even once ran a marathon backwards. Stephen was a force to be reckoned with on the rugby field and a talented photographer. I admired him. But, cancer didn't care. He died at 42. I've witnessed firsthand the financial strain cancer patients like him endure. It's heartbreaking every time — watching someone's beloved family member suffer both physically and emotionally, all-the-while grappling with mounting medical bills. I needed to take action. So, throughout my career, I dedicated my life of service to vulnerable, low income patients like my brother. And, just last year, I drafted — and successfully passed — a resolution with the Michigan Democratic Party to address the pressing issue of medical debt.

clean_body: Taking on environmental injustice in Michigan with frontline communities. | | | Friend, We all have the right to breathe clean air and drink clean water. As a voice for a district with frontline communities facing environmental racism, I know many families whose water and air are poisoned by corporate polluters. That’s why I want to support the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center. This important nonprofit organization works with communities of color and low-income communities, providing no-cost and low-cost legal services to stop dangerous air and water pollution. Alongside impacted residents, they’re holding corporate polluters and government agencies accountable for environmental injustices. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately, with 100% going directly to Great Lakes Environmental Law Center | | | | | | | | | | Thank you so much, Rashida \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Wed, Jul 26, 2023 Subject: corporate polluters profit off of poisoning our air and water To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, My congressional district has some of the worst air quality in the world, due to an extreme concentration of corporate polluters that profit off of poisoning our air and water. Because of this, Metro Detroit has some of the highest asthma rates in the country. Within Detroit, Black people are three times likelier to be hospitalized from asthma than white people. This is environmental racism. And it’s getting worse: asthma rates are on the rise. That’s why the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center’s work is so urgent. The nonprofit organization is taking on environmental injustice in Michigan, working with communities of color and low-income communities to stop dangerous air and water pollution. By providing no-cost or low-cost legal services, they help nonprofit organizations and individuals that otherwise may not be able to afford to hire an environmental lawyer. I grew up thinking it was normal that I couldn’t play outside on some days because it was too polluted. But it’s not normal. Where pollution occurs is a policy choice, and it’s environmental racism. As a voice for a district with frontline communities facing environmental racism, I advocate for policy solutions, like removing lead from all contaminated pipes and changing the EPA’s permitting process for polluting projects in order to put people’s health first. I also work alongside grassroots movements, and I know that we need leaders at all levels making the changes our communities deserve. That’s why I’m supporting the Great Lakes Environmental Law Center and their fight to hold corporate polluters and government agencies accountable for environmental injustices. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=3128%2E5257348%2EZeWU-o ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek,

In a moment, I’m going to ask you to make a donation to support the
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2023_abs_em_ecf.fRR3m9&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_FOT_GEN_AC90_20230727_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=3128%2E5257348%2EZeWU-o ]Entertainment Community Fund — an incredible nonprofit helping members
of the entertainment industry currently on strike.

But first, let me tell you why.

As you may know by now, an overwhelming 97% of members of the SAG-AFTRA
community voted to go on strike for better pay, better working conditions,
and better protections.

This is the first time both SAG-AFTRA and the Writers Guild of America
members have been on strike together since 1960.

Just last week, I marched again with members of the entertainment industry
on the picket line — where I heard their concerns firsthand.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2023_abs_em_ecf.fRR3m9&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_FOT_GEN_AC90_20230727_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=3128%2E5257348%2EZeWU-o ]Adam Schiff in SAG-AFTRA shirt carrying SAG-AFTRA strike sign with workers on
picket line

The solidarity on the SAG-AFTRA and WGA picket lines during their strikes
has been incredible.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2023_abs_em_ecf.fRR3m9&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_FOT_GEN_AC90_20230727_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=3128%2E5257348%2EZeWU-o ]Adam Schiff speaking through bullhorn on WGA picket line

The magic we see in a movie theater or on our TV isn’t by accident. It’s
thanks to the incredible writers, stunt performers, voiceover and
broadcast journalists, and actors putting in the work to make that magic
happen.

These are folks that are just trying to put bread on the table, keep a
roof over their head, provide for their families, and work enough so that
they can qualify for health insurance. In fact, more than 80 percent of
SAG-AFTRA workers don’t work enough to qualify for health insurance.

This might surprise you, but even some of the talking heads on Fox News
said they agreed with me, and that “there are a lot of people, who are
just like normal working-class people, who are working and need to have
some stuff renegotiated.”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2023_abs_em_ecf.fRR3m9&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_FOT_GEN_AC90_20230727_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=3128%2E5257348%2EZeWU-o ]Will you make a charitable donation right now to support the
Entertainment Community Fund? Your donations will go toward helping
provide a safety net for those most in need during this work stoppage —
including helping pay for medical care, housing, and grocery bills.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation to the Entertainment Community Fund will go through immediately:

This is the first time both SAG-AFTRA and the Writers Guild of America members have been on strike together since 1960. Just last week, I marched again with members of the entertainment industry on the picket line — where I heard their concerns firsthand. [ ]Adam Schiff in SAG-AFTRA shirt carrying SAG-AFTRA strike sign with workers on picket line The solidarity on the SAG-AFTRA and WGA picket lines during their strikes has been incredible. [ ]Adam Schiff speaking through bullhorn on WGA picket line The magic we see in a movie theater or on our TV isn’t by accident. It’s thanks to the incredible writers, stunt performers, voiceover and broadcast journalists, and actors putting in the work to make that magic happen. These are folks that are just trying to put bread on the table, keep a roof over their head, provide for their families, and work enough so that they can qualify for health insurance. In fact, more than 80 percent of SAG-AFTRA workers don’t work enough to qualify for health insurance. This might surprise you, but even some of the talking heads on Fox News said they agreed with me, and that “there are a lot of people, who are just like normal working-class people, who are working and need to have some stuff renegotiated.” [ ]Will you make a charitable donation right now to support the Entertainment Community Fund? This is a major victory for our fight for workers.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/67154056/418783603/1120393829?refcode=em-wrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmUzYjc3OS1iZTJjLWVlMTEtYjhmMC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yAjiHxEIYtYrpZEotBUOCoe_M4HMBsb2pCFtU2Z67bk=&emci=5b046573-be2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&emdi=32e3b779-be2c-ee11-b8f0-00224832eb73&ceid=6830379)
Our message made it to the White House, Peter.

On Tuesday, I held a thirst strike on the steps of the U.S. Capitol—not drinking any water or taking breaks all day in the sun—to push for federal protections for workers exposed to extreme heat.

**And TODAY, President Biden and Labor Secretary Julie Su****made it clear that they are listening to Texas workers by announcing new actions by the administration to protect workers from extreme heat.**

When the Supreme Court’s decision required Alabama to draw new congressional maps providing accurate representation for Black voters, Attorney General Eric Holder called it **“a victory for all Americans.”** Even though the process isn’t done yet, we won’t stop working for final, fair maps.

Then the Court issued _another_ ruling opening the door for Louisiana’s racially discriminatory maps to also be redrawn. A.G. Holder had this to say: | **“This marks another significant victory in the fight for fair representation – particularly for Black voters in Louisiana, who have had their voting rights wrongly and illegally diminished by power-hungry politicians for too long . . .

As a result of this order, Black voters in Louisiana are one step closer to receiving a fair, compliant map . . . that they have tenaciously fought for.”

_– A.G. Eric Holder_**

In both Alabama and Louisiana, Republican politicians had passed manipulated maps that diluted the power of Black votes. Now, we have the chance to put in place new, fair maps.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

Fellow Conservative,

I’ve always known that I was meant to live a life of service, but I could never have imagined that perhaps **the toughest mission of my life wouldn’t be as a Navy SEAL but rather as a combat veteran preparing to run for the United States Senate.**

[**Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to personally endorse my campaign to become the next U.S. Senator from Montana.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b376aaaf5ea444ac89b204d8afd0b245&_e=jED8TVqHBb9rGVK_Sedr9ZvBVSCJwZZ5H4wtX44vAgf5fV10NcbJH19LPS8znM1F_XpTLHQYzwSvFG1SKvQgeZLaXROjmq0ckFXUVw34Hcs0EqUcDaoU6UzqErg_ZzFh3g8en6X08YB03-_-Qy569Aj64iidynRr3lhJ1sFXToVymcsdvlFbLQQqjAg5-PGyI1se44pIKc_Jx6ymRdWhPiKjcN4J_9Xo8JvO4eFkiMGXA41de36fwc2keNOSkLT-Jd-uz0kUjpUQfxvUq6PiwOJn7LHd0eGT8nlCqxnOeyMQ4V0sb3XTJss66P_0DXwwI9j0dREeS80dUgRYoZAa8Cp2ADGOkv3vhIWHuiQiUxbVEPTlTuGDu4XxfN1Op1biPYBcmzTLQ95y_Yuh2RFUOw%3D%3D)

[**ENDORSE FMR. SEAL TIM SHEEHY TODAY** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b376aaaf5ea444ac89b204d8afd0b245&_e=jED8TVqHBb9rGVK_Sedr9ZvBVSCJwZZ5H4wtX44vAgf5fV10NcbJH19LPS8znM1F_XpTLHQYzwSvFG1SKvQgeZLaXROjmq0ckFXUVw34Hcs0EqUcDaoU6UzqErg_ZzFh3g8en6X08YB03-_-Qy569Aj64iidynRr3lhJ1sFXToVymcsdvlFbLQQqjAg5-PGyI1se44pIKc_Jx6ymRdWhPiKjcN4J_9Xo8JvO4eFkiMGXA41de36fwc2keNOSkLT-PB_AIotHBfgU-h1jfwldPqXWxqVM2pvXwmKc-JiaYgjJTO33mtnYRIt_HaSatB7lrKPE7b_xfGRP53DyA0bANyKctlODaXEQ-vw9MZ5Me4XlDKcq8aIAKn4Ndpl6OpNwbTsBaA-9qPMb8YaE53tSVQ%3D%3D)

Fellow Conservative, I am under no illusions that you will back my campaign the first time you hear from me. But my life experiences have taught me that **anything worth having requires working tirelessly, breaking down walls, and moving mountains to get it.**

**I hope you will allow me to earn your support today by reading my entire message - I promise, it’s worth the read.**

In the Navy, finding yourself between a rock and a hard place is easy. This rings especially true for the individuals who have earned the honor of serving in the elite task force that is the Navy SEALs, a group of highly trained combat warriors – a brotherhood – in which I earned a spot following my graduation from the United States Naval Academy at Annapolis.

Being a SEAL isn’t a one-man job; it takes teamwork, problem-solving, and coming to a consensus. **When you’re on missions in the harshest environments known to man, you must act as a unit and recognize you’re only as strong as the weakest among you.**

I’ve deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific during my time as a SEAL, and I have been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces and survived to tell the tales. _And believe me, there are some tales._

**I’ve seen the world’s dangers and stood up for freedom in the face of terrorism.** I know the strength it takes to stand up and fight for what is right – which is why [**I am determined to take on the anti-American, radical Left in Washington as Montana’s next U.S. Senator.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b376aaaf5ea444ac89b204d8afd0b245&_e=jED8TVqHBb9rGVK_Sedr9ZvBVSCJwZZ5H4wtX44vAgf5fV10NcbJH19LPS8znM1F_XpTLHQYzwSvFG1SKvQgeZLaXROjmq0ckFXUVw34Hcs0EqUcDaoU6UzqErg_ZzFh3g8en6X08YB03-_-Qy569Aj64iidynRr3lhJ1sFXToVymcsdvlFbLQQqjAg5-PGyI1se44pIKc_Jx6ymRdWhPiKjcN4J_9Xo8JvO4eFkiMGXA41de36fwc2keNOSkLT-bvTXZatIVo6STuc1QoDDHPqDAzPw5DDFenSAHFXZsl6ZO1G55N9Si5LphGBU6XbZgs6H6b94dUQTjkoMCe1cR8fx0_wZ173UpY8ftG-7rJVgvVs3HIruAUKxBYtVrzhHsLZSAn7DALFlleaiSMnjMQ%3D%3D)

[**ENDORSE FMR. SEAL TIM SHEEHY TODAY** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b376aaaf5ea444ac89b204d8afd0b245&_e=jED8TVqHBb9rGVK_Sedr9ZvBVSCJwZZ5H4wtX44vAgf5fV10NcbJH19LPS8znM1F_XpTLHQYzwSvFG1SKvQgeZLaXROjmq0ckFXUVw34Hcs0EqUcDaoU6UzqErg_ZzFh3g8en6X08YB03-_-Qy569Aj64iidynRr3lhJ1sFXToVymcsdvlFbLQQqjAg5-PGyI1se44pIKc_Jx6ymRdWhPiKjcN4J_9Xo8JvO4eFkiMGXA41de36fwc2keNOSkLT-7gYpZqvkHsTaMW8RSzBm2LH5kXt-4pFSn8QFBtAClBtdsuGRcWboFA4w6LOIs0C13e-NQqJzX7CT8AuyRiew0qDAWhiKAWXgGutesVySXjrWUz6akE0jZeU96o-FGTyY1773_v8EK8F3WY3iQH_FCA%3D%3D)

Our homeland is in danger. Not from overseas terrorists but Washington’s radical Democrats who want to fundamentally alter the fabric of this GREAT nation. This FAR-LEFT liberal agenda is assaulting our society, communities, and the American Dream.

**The Democrats’ grip on power is seriously undermining our freedom, prosperity, and security.**

From our elected officials attempting to make incremental changes over decades to every taxpayer in America that watches their taxes go into governmental waste. Fellow American, America's revival begins on the back of making big changes. The deep state has been exposed, now it's time to actually fight it and make America's race to the top a reality. Thanks, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Vivek 2024 Contributions to Vivek 2024 are not deductible as charitable contributions for Federal income tax purposes. body:
Hi there.

Here’s a photo of my grandparents, Arnfred and Christine, on their wedding
day in 1905. That was seven years before they picked out a flat piece of
grassland just outside Big Sandy to build their homestead.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/19007?t=1001&akid=3435%2E346206%2E0pV-Ts ][IMG]

That patch of loamy, alkaline clay-soil is the same one where I grew up;
and where Sharla and I raised our kids and still farm the land.

Things weren’t easy for Fred and Christine. They suffered devastating
windstorms, bitter cold, shooting fire, poisonous snakes—pretty much
everything but locusts. And in the late teens, the drought hit, wiping out
the farm entirely. My grandparents were forced to leave.

But they were determined to return to their homestead. They saved up
enough to start all over again on the same little piece of land. They had
a couple hundred acres to their name, a newly-built barn, a windmill,
their healthy son and daughters (including newborn Helen, my mom), strong
muscles, and the powerful work ethic that built rural America.

I first ran for office to make sure our government was serving hardworking
Americans like my grandparents a hundred years ago. Folks like our
teachers, farmers, and construction workers deserve a government that
works for them.

But too many Washington politicians are deep in the pockets of right-wing
special interests. They promise one thing when the camera is rolling, then
make secret backroom deals with their wealthy megadonors.

That’s not how I operate, and it’s why we’re running this campaign
differently. I’m counting on grassroots folks like you chipping in what
you can, when you can, to build a team strong enough to take on the
outside groups and Republican attacks.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/19008?t=1002&akid=3435%2E346206%2E0pV-Ts ]Can I count on you to split a contribution today between my campaign
and Charles Booker? Your donation (no matter the size) *sows the seeds* of
our movement, ensuring we grow and build the resources we need to win.

CHIP IN →

Thanks for your support. Together, we can keep me in Washington fighting
for the little guy.

Jon

clean_body: | | Team, whenever partisan extremism knocks us back, voters keep getting back up and pushing forward. Since Roe fell last year, we’ve supported organizers in Vermont and Michigan to codify the right to a safe and legal abortion. And every time, we've succeeded. It’s rock solid proof that direct democracy can work in favor of abortion rights when women everywhere step up and get involved. But these victories cannot and will not be the end of this story. We’re hearing murmurs that Arizona could be the next big fight to save reproductive freedom, so we wanted to ask... Do you think it’s time to restore Roe in Arizona with a ballot measure? If last year’s wins have proven anything, it’s that the BEST way we can defend reproductive health care access for all is with direct democracy. We know that when abortion access is on the ballot, it wins. We have to keep fighting back against threats to our rights, year after year, state after state. Peter,
As Heidi’s Treasurer, it’s my job to keep track of all of our campaign finances – which means I’ve spent a LOT of time looking at fundraising numbers recently.
Gingrich dropping out has blown this race wide open, and I’m worried that we’re not on pace to run our full voter outreach program before time runs out.
With just one week to go until Election Day, we need to reach as many voters as possible. Peter, can you chip in any amount today to help us connect with Nashvillians before they return their ballots? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230727_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
CHIP IN >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230727_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
Even with a dedicated group of volunteers, voter outreach is still very costly. Our door-knocking teams need clipboards, mailers and pens to spread the word about Heidi – not to mention waters, snacks, and lunches for long days out in the field.
Peter, Music City is facing many critical issues: traffic congestion, a lack of affordable housing, and a hostile takeover by the state’s controlling party.
We need a proven leader and bridge-builder like Heidi to defend our city and make sure that Nashville emerges from these challenges stronger than ever.
With the election so close, we can’t afford to be under-resourced. Peter, will you contribute today to help us fund our voter outreach strategy, reach our final End of Month Fundraising Goal, and finish out the week with a win? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230727_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]

With gratitude,
Chip Forrester, Treasurer
Campbell for Mayor
Heidi Campbell is a Nashville native, Mom, former music industry executive and the first female mayor of the city of Oak Hill.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230727_em_fr_b1_CF_acq [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230727_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
As mayor, Heidi established a track record for fiscal discipline, balancing the budget every year of her Mayorship, eliminating my own salary, and returning $2M to my city’s reserves.
Heidi was elected in November of 2020 to represent District 20 in the Tennessee State Senate. Since then, she’s been an outspoken advocate for science, the LGBTQ community, public education, local control, women's and kids' issues, Medicaid expansion, and the environment.
Heidi sponsored or co-sponsored over 100 pieces of legislation in her first year in the senate, including legislation to allow cities to offer paid family leave, increase funding for school counselors and reading interventionists, and make it easier to cast a vote.
Heidi is focused on sustainable infrastructure, economic development and job creation, fully funding our public schools and supporting educators, expanding access to affordable healthcare, investing in suicide prevention, making certain that vulnerable children in state custody are not falling through the cracks, and ensuring that every Tennessean - regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age or ability - can achieve the American Dream.
Election Day is Thursday, August 3, 2023.

Sinema took in $100,000 from the airlines, and now she’s leading the charge to weaken pilot training requirements.
#

Remember that Schoolhouse Rock video, Peter?
The one about how a bill becomes a law? Everyone had to watch it in elementary school. This wasn’t one of the verses:
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-july23.8cMi4H&refcode=em230727-2-30&t=1&akid=857%2E734936%2EmeXxUn)

body:
I realize that number might sound humble, but I want to explain why your donation today matters so much.
#
$5.
While that number might sound humble, Derek, it's the exact amount I'm asking you to please chip in today to support my work and protect our seat in the Senate.
**Why $5, you might ask?** 🤔 Because, while one single donation of $5 may not sound like a lot on its own, someone else reading this email today might just step up to join you in donating $5 too. And then all those gifts of $5 will start to add up.
**Basically, if enough of yinz who open this email today decide to kick in $5, the sum of all those online donations will make a *really* big dent in the sizable hole we've got in our organizing budget.** That is exactly how you + a lot of other folks on this team can come together to keep powering our work in the Senate.
I understand that not _every_ person who reads my emails will choose to donate $5 before our deadline on Monday, Derek, but truthfully I'm REALLY hoping you'll be among those who do.
**[I gotta ask: Will you chip in $5 to our people-powered campaign to protect our razor-thin Democratic majority? I'd be so grateful.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230727-1?refcode=em20230727-1-8480&refcode2=8480_434096_qF12re&akid=8480%2E434096%2EqF12re)** 🙏

I've never been much of a numbers guy myself, but I know deep in my heart that this is how we’ll keep Democrats in control of the Senate. That's right, just good old-fashioned people power. Brick by brick, dollar by dollar, vote by vote.
Like I always say: **Every county, every vote.** 💯
**[If you think protecting our Democratic Senate majority is worth it, please take a moment to donate. We’re thankful for every donation!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230727-1?refcode=em20230727-1-8480&refcode2=8480_434096_qF12re&akid=8480%2E434096%2EqF12re)**
Thanks for hearing me out, Derek, and have an incredible weekend.
John ❤️

U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

That means everything from participating in local parades to talking to Democratic county parties. Then, I take what I learn and use our campaign resources to help elevate and support strong Democrats at all levels of government and share Martin’s record with voters and supporters. You have an important role to play here, too. Every single dollar we raise from our grassroots fundraising program goes toward initiatives like the ones I mentioned, voter outreach, and more. = My work for Martin’s Senate re-election campaign is rooted in a strong history in our state. I am a 13th-generation New Mexican, and my family has been in the Middle Rio Grande Valley — where I still live today — since the 1700s.
